def prepare_binder(workflow, reader, binder, acceptance, receipts, build_path,
                   source_path, installed_identity, task):
    """Authenticate the incoming loader, then rebuild a private exact namespace.

    A legacy caller may already have installed 4b556. Its verified executable is
    never changed or wrapped again. Replayed native evidence uses a separate
    canonical acceptance namespace and exactly one new extension installation.
    """
    base = binder
    if isinstance(binder, types.FunctionType) and binder.__name__ == 'bound':
        raw = reader.raw(Path(binder.__code__.co_filename), 128 << 10)
        pin = sha(raw)
        need(pin in (OLD_FIXED_SHA, workflow.FIXED_SHA), 'unknown caller fixed-intent extension')
        closure = dict(zip(binder.__code__.co_freevars,
                           [x.cell_contents for x in binder.__closure__ or ()]))
        need(closure.get('pa') is acceptance and isinstance(closure.get('binder'), types.FunctionType),
             'caller fixed-intent closure differs')
        future = binder.__code__.co_flags & __future__.annotations.compiler_flag
        compiled = compile(raw, binder.__code__.co_filename, 'exec', flags=future, dont_inherit=True)
        def codes(code):
            for value in code.co_consts:
                if isinstance(value, types.CodeType):
                    yield value
                    yield from codes(value)
        matches = [c for c in codes(compiled) if c.co_name == 'bound']
        need(len(matches) == 1 and workflow._same_code(matches[0], binder.__code__),
             'caller fixed-intent executable differs')
        base = closure['binder']
    else:
        pin = None
    workflow._verify_binder(base, acceptance, receipts)
    source = reader.raw(Path(base.__code__.co_filename[:-len(':pure-action-binding')]), 1 << 20)
    need(sha(source) == workflow.SUITE_SHA, 'canonical model binder source differs')
    acceptance_raw = reader.raw(Path(acceptance.__file__), 1 << 20)
    need(sha(acceptance_raw) == workflow.ACCEPTANCE_SHA, 'canonical acceptance source differs')
    import model_profiles
    need(sha(reader.raw(Path(model_profiles.__file__), 1 << 20)) == MODEL_PROFILES_SHA,
         'canonical model profiles source differs')
    private = types.ModuleType('controller_idle_private_acceptance_v56_r2')
    private.__file__ = acceptance.__file__
    exec(compile(acceptance_raw, acceptance.__file__, 'exec', dont_inherit=True), private.__dict__)
    # The closed archive adapter below has no process, transport, or Adb method.
    # Guard the unused constructor too, so no future call can fall back to IO.
    def no_device(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError('live device construction forbidden in terminal replay')
    private.Adb.__init__ = no_device
    functions = {'_evidence_object', '_action_identity', '_collected_bytes', '_warm_task_model_binding',
        'model_action_binding', '_ime_submit_action_binding', '_submit_journal_identity'}
    constants = {'SHA', 'PKG', 'IME_SUBMIT_IDENTITY', 'BACKGROUND_GENERATION'}
    nodes = [n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in functions
        or isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)
        and n.targets[0].id in constants]
    namespace = {'acceptance': private, 'json': json, 'Path': Path, 're': re,
        **{n: getattr(receipts, n) for n in ('APP_REQUEST', 'NATIVE_REQUEST', 'request_contract', 'session_contract', 'collection_verified')}}
    future = base.__code__.co_flags & __future__.annotations.compiler_flag
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), base.__code__.co_filename,
                 'exec', flags=future, dont_inherit=True), namespace)
    new_base = namespace['model_action_binding']
    workflow._verify_binder(new_base, private, receipts)
    fixed_path = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name('fixed_intent_v6_acceptance.py')
    fixed_raw = reader.raw(fixed_path, 128 << 10)
    need(sha(fixed_raw) == workflow.FIXED_SHA, 'new fixed-intent evidence source differs')
    fixed = types.ModuleType('controller_idle_fixed_v56_r2')
    fixed.__file__ = str(fixed_path)
    exec(compile(fixed_raw, str(fixed_path), 'exec', dont_inherit=True), fixed.__dict__)
    new_binder = fixed.install(private, new_base)
    source_binding = fixed.bind_v56_source_context(private, build_path, source_path,
                                                  installed_identity, task)
    workflow._verify_binder(new_binder, private, receipts)
    return private, new_binder, source_binding, pin


class ArchiveOnlyCollection:
    """Read only hash-bound task/request/worker files; never construct a device."""
    def __init__(self, archive, task):
        self.archive, self.task = archive, task

    def app_bytes(self, relative, *, optional=False):
        prefix = 'files/control-tasks/' + self.task + '/'
        if relative.startswith(prefix):
            name = 'task/' + relative[len(prefix):]
        else:
            need(re.fullmatch(r'files/runs/[0-9a-f]{32}/[^/]+', relative),
                 'unexpected archive-only private path')
            name = relative[len('files/'):]
        if optional and name not in self.archive.manifest:
            return None
        return self.archive.bound(name)

    def list_children(self, relative, directories=False):
        if relative == 'files/runs' and directories:
            return sorted({p.split('/')[1] for p in self.archive.manifest if p.startswith('runs/')})
        need(not directories, 'unexpected archive-only directory enumeration')
        if relative == 'files/control-tasks/' + self.task:
            prefix = 'task/'
        else:
            need(re.fullmatch(r'files/runs/[0-9a-f]{32}', relative), 'unexpected archive-only enumeration')
            prefix = relative[len('files/'):] + '/'
        return sorted(n[len(prefix):] for n in self.archive.manifest
                      if n.startswith(prefix) and '/' not in n[len(prefix):])


def collection_comparison(original, replay):
    """New v56 collections must match every original nonimage gate and byte."""
    def normalized(value):
        value = strict(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode())
        value.pop('omitted_screenshots', None)
        for group in [value] + value.get('associated_runs', []) + value.get('task_model_sessions', []):
            if 'files' in group:
                group['files'] = sorted([r for r in group['files']
                    if not r['path'].lower().endswith(('.png', '.webp', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '/image.bin'))],
                    key=lambda r: r['path'])
        return value
    old, new = normalized(original), normalized(replay)
    old_rows = {r['run_id']: r for r in old.get('associated_runs', [])}
    new_rows = {r['run_id']: r for r in new.get('associated_runs', [])}
    need(old_rows and len(old_rows) == len(old.get('associated_runs', []))
         and len(new_rows) == len(new.get('associated_runs', [])) and set(new_rows) == set(old_rows),
         'unique matching actual original/recomputed runs required')
    need(all(old_rows[r].get('controller_grammar_binding_valid') is True
             and new_rows[r].get('controller_grammar_binding_valid') is True for r in old_rows),
         'original and recomputed v56 grammar gates must both be valid')
    need(same(old, new), 'new v56 native collection must match all original nonimage gates and bytes')
    return {'same_existing_gate_results':True,'changes':[],
        'original_collection_mutated':False,'screenshots_not_recollected':True,
        'complete_nonimage_membership_and_bytes_equal':True}


def actual_input_ids(reader, directory, collected, collection, archive):
    """Independent original LE32 bytes, original sidecar, native and SDK closure."""
    sidecar_raw = reader.raw(directory / 'evidence/input-ids-binary-collection.json')
    sidecar = strict(sidecar_raw)
    need(same(sidecar, collected.get('input_ids_evidence'))
         and sidecar.get('schema') == 'hepta.input-ids-binary-collection.v1'
         and sidecar.get('task_id') == collection['task_id']
         and sidecar.get('original_collection_sha256') == sha(reader.raw(directory / 'evidence/collection.json')),
         'original input-ID sidecar/task/collection differs')
    rows = sidecar.get('runs')
    runs = {r['run_id'] for r in collection['associated_runs']}
    need(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == len(runs)
         and {r.get('run_id') for r in rows} == runs, 'complete original input-ID run set required')
    verified = []
    for row in rows:
        run = row['run_id']; name = 'runs/' + run + '/formatted-input-ids.le32'
        need(row.get('path') == name, 'input-ID path differs')
        raw = reader.raw(directory / 'evidence' / name, 16 << 20)
        need(raw and len(raw) % 4 == 0 and type(row.get('bytes')) is int
             and len(raw) == row['bytes'] and sha(raw) == row.get('sha256'), 'actual LE32 bytes differ')
        native = archive.bound_obj('runs/' + run + '/native-result.json')
        meta = archive.bound_obj('runs/' + run + '/prompt-evidence.json')
        budget, profile = native.get('prompt_budget') or {}, native.get('profile') or {}
        count = len(raw) // 4
        need(native.get('request_id') == meta.get('request_id') == run
             and meta.get('schema') == 'hepta.private-prompt-evidence.v1'
             and meta.get('input_ids_encoding') == 'uint32-little-endian'
             and type(meta.get('input_ids_bytes')) is int and meta['input_ids_bytes'] == len(raw)
             and all(type(x) is int and x == count for x in (budget.get('input_ids_count'),
                  budget.get('prompt_tokens_exact'), meta.get('input_ids_count'), profile.get('prompt_tokens')))
             and sha(raw) == budget.get('input_ids_sha256') == meta.get('input_ids_sha256')
             and budget.get('method') == 'llama_tokenize_exact_same_input_ids'
             and budget.get('is_exact_token_count') is True and budget.get('input_ids_passed_directly') is True
             and meta.get('input_ids_will_be_passed_directly') is True,
             'actual LE32/native budget/prompt metadata/SDK count binding differs')
        verified.append({'run_id': run, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'count': count})
    return {'all_actual_input_ids_verified': True, 'runs': verified, 'retokenization_claimed': False,
            'sidecar_sha256': sha(sidecar_raw)}


def verify(directory, result_sha, session, terminal_raw, expected_task, expected_uid,
           expected_apk, expected_config, binder, acceptance, receipts,
           actual_build_receipt_path, actual_build_receipt_sha256, controller_source_path):
    """Accept only a real controller terminal backed by its original run tree.

    `directory` is the completed BG collector output, not the task subdirectory.
    `session` is the caller's fresh parsed control-session; `terminal_raw` is its
    fresh exact private task result bytes. Actual signed build bytes are read
    and hashed here, not represented by a caller-supplied verified boolean.
    `expected_config` is the caller's CURRENT config expectation. A completed
    historical task may precede a legitimate profile change; its original
    collector hash and native evidence remain bound to that historical task.
    Current config bytes still require the caller's existing fresh live guard.
    """
    result = {'schema': 'hepta.controller-terminal-idle-compatibility.v1',
        'idle_compatible': False, 'qualified': False, 'business_qualification_assigned': False,
        'live_current_idle_resources_verified_here': False,
        'device_actions_executed': False, 'legacy_terminal_predicates_changed': False,
        'required_outer_guards': ['fresh immutable owner/PPID/FLOCK', 'fresh installed UID/full APK and config',
            'fresh no worker/broker/owned display/unresolved journal', 'unchanged task/model history',
            'existing no-retry and no-new-task predicates']}
    reader = Reader()
    try:
        need(isinstance(session, dict) and session.get('status') == 'controller_verified_done',
             'this helper supports only the new controller terminal; legacy states use the original path')
        need(isinstance(terminal_raw, bytes) and 0 < len(terminal_raw) <= 2 << 20,
             'fresh exact terminal bytes required')
        need(isinstance(expected_task, str) and HEX32.fullmatch(expected_task)
             and type(expected_uid) is int and expected_uid == 10481
             and all(isinstance(x, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(x) for x in
                     (result_sha, expected_apk, expected_config, actual_build_receipt_sha256)),
             'actual task/UID/full identity pins required')
        need(actual_build_receipt_sha256 == EXPECTED_V56_BUILD_SHA
             and expected_apk == EXPECTED_V56_APK_SHA,
             'new v56 history requires its own actual signed APK/build; all v51/v53/v54 history stays separate')
        directory = Path(directory)
        need(directory.is_absolute() and directory.is_dir() and '..' not in directory.parts
             and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (directory, *directory.parents)),
             'exact original collector output directory required')
        collected_raw = reader.raw(directory / 'RESULT.json')
        need(sha(collected_raw) == result_sha, 'original collector RESULT SHA differs')
        collected = strict(collected_raw)
        need(isinstance(collected, dict) and collected.get('task_id') == expected_task
             and collected.get('expected_app_uid') == expected_uid
             and collected.get('expected_apk_sha256') == expected_apk,
             'actual collector task/APK differs')
        historical_config = collected.get('runtime_config_sha256')
        need(isinstance(historical_config, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(historical_config),
             'historical collector runtime config SHA missing')
        need(same(collected.get('last_session'), session),
             'fresh current session differs from the actual terminal collector session')
        terminal_path = directory / 'evidence/task/result.json'
        original_terminal = reader.raw(terminal_path, 2 << 20)
        need(original_terminal == terminal_raw, 'fresh private terminal bytes differ from original collected result')
        terminal = strict(original_terminal)
        need(isinstance(terminal, dict) and terminal.get('task_id') == expected_task
             and terminal.get('status') == 'controller_verified_done', 'actual controller terminal identity differs')

        build_raw = reader.raw(Path(actual_build_receipt_path), 1 << 20)
        need(sha(build_raw) == actual_build_receipt_sha256, 'actual signed-build receipt SHA differs')
        build = strict(build_raw)
        need(isinstance(build, dict) and build.get('schema') == EXPECTED_V56_BUILD_SCHEMA
             and type(build.get('version_code')) is int and build['version_code'] == EXPECTED_V56_VERSION_CODE
             and build.get('all_pass') is True and type(build.get('exit_code')) is int and build['exit_code'] == 0
             and build.get('apk_sha256') == expected_apk and type(build.get('apk_bytes')) is int and build['apk_bytes'] > 0
             and build.get('matches_previously_recorded_signer') is True
             and build.get('signer_certificate_sha256') == SIGNER_SHA
             and build.get('signer_proof_sha256') == SIGNER_PROOF_SHA
             and build.get('new_key_created') is False and build.get('existing_key_metadata_unchanged') is True
             and build.get('source_files_unchanged') is True
             and build.get('actual_compiler_inputs_bound_to_signed_asset') is True
             and isinstance(build.get('source_commit'), str) and HEX40.fullmatch(build['source_commit'])
             and isinstance(build.get('source_inventory_sha256'), str) and HEX64.fullmatch(build['source_inventory_sha256'])
             and all(type(build.get(k)) is int and build[k] > 0 for k in
                     ('source_file_count', 'host_check_records', 'host_input_count', 'actual_compiler_source_inputs')),
             'actual signed v56 assembly identity/old signer gates missing')
        binding = {'build_receipt_sha256': actual_build_receipt_sha256,
            'source_commit': build['source_commit'], 'source_inventory_sha256': build['source_inventory_sha256'],
            'version_code': EXPECTED_V56_VERSION_CODE, 'apk_sha256': expected_apk, 'same_signer_verified_by_actual_receipt': True}
        need(same(collected.get('actual_build_binding'), binding),
             'collector build metadata does not match the actual signed receipt bytes')

        installed = collected.get('installed_identity_before')
        need(isinstance(installed, dict) and same(installed, collected.get('installed_identity_after')),
             'actual installed identity changed during task')
        app = installed.get('hepta') or {}
        apks = app.get('apks')
        need(app.get('package') == PACKAGE and type(app.get('uid')) is int and app['uid'] == expected_uid
             and isinstance(apks, list) and len(apks) == 1 and apks[0].get('sha256') == expected_apk,
             'actual collector installed Hepta UID/full APK differs')
        collection = reader.obj(directory / 'evidence/collection.json')
        need(same(collection, collected.get('collection')), 'actual collection differs from collector RESULT')
        bootstrap = reader.obj(directory / 'evidence/task/background-bootstrap.json')
        helper_path = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name('controller_workflow_evidence.py')
        helper_raw = reader.raw(helper_path, 128 << 10)
        need(sha(helper_raw) == WORKFLOW_SHA, 'independent controller workflow verifier source changed')
        workflow = types.ModuleType('actual_controller_idle_workflow')
        workflow.__file__ = str(helper_path)
        exec(compile(helper_raw, str(helper_path), 'exec', dont_inherit=True), workflow.__dict__)
        original_grammar = acceptance.controller_grammar_binding_valid
        private, replay_binder, source_binding, caller_extension = prepare_binder(
            workflow, reader, binder, acceptance, receipts, Path(actual_build_receipt_path),
            Path(controller_source_path), app, expected_task)
        need(type(collection.get('context_expected')) is int and collection['context_expected'] == 8192
             and collection.get('compute_expected') == collected.get('compute') == 'npu'
             and collection.get('model_profile_expected') == collected.get('model_profile'),
             'actual archived runtime context/compute/profile differs')
        preparation_raw = reader.raw(directory / 'PREPARATION-ORIGINAL.json', 2 << 20)
        need(sha(preparation_raw) == collected.get('preparation_sha256'),
             'archived actual dual UI preparation differs from original collector binding')
        original_preference = strict(preparation_raw)['ui_preferences_original']
        preference_raw = reader.raw(directory / 'PREPARATION-UI-CHOICE-ORIGINAL.xml', 65536)
        need(preference_raw == original_preference['raw_utf8'].encode('utf-8', 'strict')
             and sha(preference_raw) == original_preference['sha256']
             and sha(preference_raw) == collected.get('ui_preferences_original_sha256')
             and collected.get('ui_preferences_unchanged') is True
             and preference_raw == reader.raw(directory / 'BEFORE-TASK-UI-CHOICE.xml', 65536)
             and preference_raw == reader.raw(directory / 'AFTER-TASK-UI-CHOICE.xml', 65536),
             'actual original dual UI preferences were not preserved across the task')
        original_archive = workflow.Collected(directory / 'evidence', collection, private)
        ids_proof = actual_input_ids(reader, directory, collected, collection, original_archive)
        # All writes go to a fresh temporary mirror, never the original run tree.
        temporary_root = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).resolve()
        need(not temporary_root.is_relative_to(directory.resolve()), 'temporary replay cannot be inside original evidence')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hepta-controller-idle-native-replay-', dir=str(temporary_root)) as temporary:
            replay_directory = Path(temporary)
            replay = private.collect_evidence(ArchiveOnlyCollection(original_archive, expected_task),
                replay_directory, expected_task, collected['instruction'], set(), False, expected_uid,
                collected['compute'], collection['context_expected'], collected['model_profile'])
            comparison = collection_comparison(collection, replay)
            need(replay.get('errors') == [] and receipts.collection_verified(replay) is True,
                 'independent actual native/session replay failed')
            replay_collection_sha = sha(reader.raw(replay_directory / 'collection.json'))
            # A temporary output path must not be part of retained original refs.
            reader.reads.pop(str(replay_directory / 'collection.json'))
            proof = workflow.analyze_workflow(replay_directory, replay, terminal, session,
                collected.get('plan'), installed.get('notes'), bootstrap, replay_binder, private, receipts,
                preparation_raw, collected.get('preparation_sha256'), collected.get('plan_sha256'))
        need(acceptance.controller_grammar_binding_valid is original_grammar,
             'caller acceptance namespace was changed')
        need(original_archive.unchanged(), 'original collection files changed during private replay')
        need(proof.get('verified') is True and proof.get('qualified') is False
             and proof.get('native_worker_session_cleanup_bound') is True
             and proof.get('actual_parent_is_last_native_request') is True
             and proof.get('actual_stable_readback_verified') is True
             and proof.get('original_bytes_unchanged') is True,
             'actual controller/native/child/cleanup replay failed: ' + str(proof.get('missing_or_invalid')))
        need(proof.get('task_id') == expected_task and type(proof.get('display_id')) is int
             and proof['display_id'] > 0, 'independent replay task/nonzero lease differs')
        need(reader.unchanged(), 'original collector/build bytes changed during verification')
        result.update(idle_compatible=True, status='controller_verified_done', task_id=expected_task,
            app_uid=expected_uid, apk_sha256=expected_apk,
            historical_runtime_config_sha256=historical_config,
            current_expected_config_sha256=expected_config, same_config=historical_config == expected_config,
            historical_config_source='original collector RESULT bound by the supplied exact SHA; native requests independently replayed',
            current_runtime_config_verified_here=False,
            original_collector_result_sha256=result_sha, original_private_terminal_sha256=sha(terminal_raw),
            actual_signed_build_binding=binding, controller_workflow_verifier_sha256=WORKFLOW_SHA,
            original_canonical_binder_reverified=True, fixed_v6_extension_added_here=True, caller_extension_sha256=caller_extension,
            private_acceptance_namespace_used=True, caller_acceptance_namespace_unchanged=True,
            actual_source_context=source_binding, original_collection_sha256=sha(reader.raw(directory / "evidence/collection.json")),
            independently_recomputed_collection_sha256=replay_collection_sha, collection_comparison=comparison,
            actual_input_ids=ids_proof,
            controller_chain_recomputed=True, native_worker_session_cleanup_bound=True,
            workflow_id=proof['workflow_id'], parent_model_run_id=proof['parent']['parent_run_id'],
            display_id=proof['display_id'], generation=proof['generation'],
            workflow_summary={k: proof[k] for k in ('owner_sha256', 'body_sha256', 'contract_sha256',
                'backs', 'clicks', 'final_observation_id', 'actual_stable_readback_verified',
                'actual_parent_is_last_native_request', 'native_worker_session_cleanup_bound',
                'original_model_reported_success', 'original_model_done_status', 'model_done_synthesized',
                'collection_sha256', 'original_bytes_unchanged')},
            workflow_input_count=len(proof.get('input_inventory', [])),
            workflow_input_inventory_sha256=sha(json.dumps(proof.get('input_inventory', []),
                ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode()),
            scope='Only compatibility of this byte-bound controller terminal with the unchanged outer idle guards; no model/visual/Settings/business qualification is assigned.')
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, RuntimeError, UnicodeError, AttributeError) as error:
        result['missing_or_invalid'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
    result['source_refs'] = reader.refs()
    return result

def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def module(path, expected, name):
    need(path.is_absolute() and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), "exact absolute helper path required")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    need(sha(raw) == expected, "frozen helper differs: " + name)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    exec(compile(raw, str(path), "exec"), value.__dict__)
    return value


def read_ui_preferences(adb, expected_uid, label):
    """Fixed read-only SharedPreferences path. No write, repair, or app input."""
    relative = "shared_prefs/background-ui-choice-v1.xml"
    code, raw = adb.command(["run-as", PKG, "sh", "-c",
        "test -d shared_prefs && test ! -L shared_prefs && "
        "test -f " + relative + " && test ! -L " + relative + " && "
        "test ! -e " + relative + ".bak && test ! -L " + relative + ".bak && echo PRESENT"],
        label=label + "-preference-path", raw=True)
    need(code == 0 and raw.strip() == b"PRESENT", "actual ordinary preference path unavailable")
    command = ["run-as", PKG, "stat", "-c", "%d %i %u %s %h %f %Y %Z", relative]
    code, before = adb.command(command, label=label + "-preference-stat", raw=True)
    fields = before.decode("ascii", "strict").strip().split()
    need(code == 0 and len(fields) == 8
         and all(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", fields[i]) for i in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7))
         and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]+", fields[5]), "actual preference stat format differs")
    mode = int(fields[5], 16)
    need(int(fields[1]) > 0 and int(fields[2]) == expected_uid and int(fields[4]) == 1
         and stat.S_ISREG(mode)
         and 0 < int(fields[3]) <= 65536, "actual private preference UID/mode/link/size differs")
    code, value = adb.command(["run-as", PKG, "head", "-c", "65537", relative],
        label=label + "-preference-read", raw=True)
    need(code == 0 and len(value) == int(fields[3]), "actual preference read length differs")
    code, after = adb.command(command, label=label + "-preference-stat-after", raw=True)
    need(code == 0 and after == before, "actual preference file changed while read")
    return value


def recent_task_report(raw):
    """Conservative report of exact-package references; never removes a task."""
    header = "ACTIVITY MANAGER RECENT TASKS (dumpsys activity recents)"
    recognized = len(re.findall(r"^" + re.escape(header) + r"[ \t]*$", raw, re.M)) == 1
    pattern = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])" + re.escape(TARGET) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_.])")
    matches = [{"line": index, "text": line} for index, line in enumerate(raw.splitlines(), 1) if pattern.search(line)]
    return {"schema": "hepta.background-preparation-recents.v1", "dump_sha256": sha(raw.encode()),
            "recognized_header": recognized, "target_references": matches,
            "target_reference_present": bool(matches), "task_removal_attempted": False,
            "scope": "exact-package references in the complete observed recents dump; any match blocks readiness"}


def scope_button(ui):
    matches = []
    for node in ui["xml"].iter("node"):
        if node.get("package") != PKG or node.get("enabled") != "true":
            continue
        label = node.get("text", "")
        if label == "选择后台应用范围":
            matches.append((node, 0))
        else:
            match = re.fullmatch(r"后台范围：([1-6]) 个应用（更改）", label)
            if match:
                matches.append((node, int(match.group(1))))
    need(len(matches) <= 1, "background scope button ambiguous")
    return matches[0] if matches else None


def visible_in(helper, node, viewport):
    if node.get("visible-to-user") == "false":
        return False
    try:
        l, t, r, b = helper.bounds(node)
    except RuntimeError:
        return False
    return viewport[0] <= l < r <= viewport[2] and viewport[1] <= t < b <= viewport[3]


def choice_rows(ui, helper):
    helper.exact_node(ui, "本次后台可操作应用（最多 6 个）")
    lists = [n for n in ui["xml"].iter("node") if n.get("package") == PKG and n.get("class") == "android.widget.ListView"]
    need(len(lists) == 1, "one observed background app list required")
    viewport = helper.bounds(lists[0])
    rows = {}
    for n in lists[0].iter("node"):
        match = re.fullmatch(r".+ · ([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+)", n.get("text", ""))
        if not match or n.get("package") != PKG or not visible_in(helper, n, viewport):
            continue
        need(n.get("checkable") == "true" and n.get("checked") in ("true", "false")
             and n.get("enabled") == "true", "observed app row is not an enabled checkbox")
        package = match.group(1)
        need(package not in rows, "duplicate visible app package")
        rows[package] = n
    need(rows, "no supported visible background app choices")
    return lists[0], rows

        def swipe(scroll, reason):
            need(scroll.get("scrollable") == "true", "observed container is not scrollable")
            box = uihelper.bounds(scroll)
            x, height = (box[0] + box[2]) // 2, box[3] - box[1]
            coords = [x, box[1] + height * 3 // 4, x, box[1] + height // 3]
            adb.command(["input", "-d", "0", "swipe", *map(str, coords), "350"], label=reason)

        adb.command(["am", "start", "-a", "android.intent.action.MAIN", "-c", "android.intent.category.LAUNCHER", "-n", PKG + "/.MainActivity", "--es", "task", instruction], label="ordinary-hepta-main-prefill-only")
        ui = capture("prefilled")

        mode = uihelper.exact_node(ui, "在后台空间操作")

        for index in range(4):
            ui = capture("unfocus-%02d" % index)

            need(index < 6, "scope selector not exposed by bounded ordinary scrolling")
            swipe(scroll, "scroll-hepta-to-background-scope")
        tap(button, "open-background-app-choices")
        handled, target_selected, prior_page, pending_toggle = set(), set(), None, None
        selected_labels = {}
        for index in range(32):
            ui = capture("app-choices-%02d" % index)
            scroll, rows = choice_rows(ui, uihelper)
            if pending_toggle is not None:
                package, expected_checked = pending_toggle
                need(package in rows and rows[package].get("checked") == expected_checked, "ordinary checkbox tap did not produce the required observed state")
                pending_toggle = None
            changed = False
            for package, row in rows.items():
                if package in UI_PACKAGES:
                    label = row.get("text", "")[:-len(" · " + package)]
                    need(label and (package not in selected_labels or selected_labels[package] == label),
                         "actual selected app label changed during ordinary chooser")
                    selected_labels[package] = label
                if row.get("checked") == "true" and package not in handled and (package not in UI_PACKAGES or package not in target_selected):
                    need(len(handled) < original_count, "selected checkbox count differs from original visible scope count")
                    handled.add(package)
                    if package not in UI_PACKAGES:
                        tap(row, "unselect-other-background-app")
                        pending_toggle = (package, "false")
                        changed = True
                        break
                    target_selected.add(package)
                if package in UI_PACKAGES and package not in target_selected:
                    need(row.get("checked") == "false", "target checkbox changed unexpectedly")
                    tap(row, "select-explicit-default-background-app")
                    target_selected.add(package)
                    pending_toggle = (package, "true")
                    changed = True
                    break
            if changed:
                prior_page = None
                continue
            if target_selected == UI_PACKAGES and len(handled) == original_count:
                tap(uihelper.exact_node(ui, "使用所选应用"), "confirm-notes-and-helper-background-apps")
                break
            signature = tuple((p, n.get("checked")) for p, n in rows.items())
            need(index < 31 and signature != prior_page, "required target/previous selection not found in bounded observed choices")
            prior_page = signature
            swipe(scroll, "scroll-background-app-choices")
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("background selection did not settle")
        ui = capture("dual-default-background-apps-selected")
        uihelper.exact_node(ui, "后台范围：2 个应用（更改）")
        need(set(selected_labels) == UI_PACKAGES, "both selected app labels must come from actual chooser rows")
        expected_auto = "本次将自动使用：" + selected_labels[TARGET] + "。已保存的应用范围保持不变。"
        for index in range(7):

            swipe(scroll, "scroll-hepta-automatic-target-into-view")

        spinners = [n for n in ui["xml"].iter("node") if n.get("package") == PKG
                    and n.get("class") == "android.widget.Spinner"]
        need(not spinners, "recognized Notes OWNER must hide the initial-app Spinner")
        preferences_raw = read_ui_preferences(adb, args.expected_uid, "ordinary-choice-saved")
        saved_choice = plan_helper.preference_choice(preferences_raw)
        r7.write_new(args.out / "background-ui-choice-original.xml", preferences_raw, binary=True)
        report["ui_preferences_original"] = {"file": "background-ui-choice-original.xml",
            "bytes": len(preferences_raw), "sha256": sha(preferences_raw),
            "raw_utf8": preferences_raw.decode("utf-8", "strict")}
        report["background_selection"] = {"allowed_packages": sorted(UI_PACKAGES),
            "bootstrap_package": saved_choice["initial"], "scope_count": 2,
            "automatic_target_text": expected_auto, "initial_spinner_hidden": True,
            "selection_source": "ordinary_visible_multi_choice_and_persisted_initial"}
        for index in range(7):
            ui = capture("start-viewport-%02d" % index)
            scroll = uihelper.outer_scroll(ui)
            start = uihelper.visible_start(ui, uihelper.bounds(scroll))
            if start is not None:
                report.update(start_point=uihelper.point(start), start_bounds=uihelper.bounds(start), final_ui_label="start-viewport-%02d" % index)
                break
            need(index < 6, "Start not exposed by bounded ordinary scrolling")
            swipe(scroll, "scroll-hepta-start-into-view")
        # Last UiAutomation capture has finished. Only read binding/geometry/PNG
        # below, so the formal service can rebind before r12's separate run.
        binding = {"verified": False}
        for index in range(10):
            services = text(["dumpsys", "activity", "services", PKG + "/.HeptaAccessibilityService"], "formal-service-rebind")
            try:
                binding = r7.formal_service_binding(services, args.expected_uid)
                break
            except RuntimeError:
                time.sleep(1)
        need(binding.get("verified") is True, "formal accessibility service did not rebind; no setting/grant attempted")
        report["formal_service_binding"] = binding
        display = text(["dumpsys", "display"], "logical-display-mapping")
        physical = text(["dumpsys", "SurfaceFlinger", "--display-id"], "physical-display-mapping")
        mapping = r7.main_physical_display_mapping(display, physical, args.main_physical_display_id)
        windows = text(["dumpsys", "window", "displays"], "prepared-window-displays")
        screen = adb.command(["screencap", "-p", "-d", args.main_physical_display_id], label="prepared-original-main-png", raw=True)[1]
        r7.write_new(args.out / "prepared-window.txt", windows.encode(), binary=True)
        r7.write_new(args.out / "prepared-main.png", screen, binary=True)
        with r7.png_rgba(screen) as image:
            need(list(image.size) == mapping["screen_size"], "main screenshot dimensions differ")
            geometry = r7.system_bar_content_geometry(windows, image.size)
            after = text(["dumpsys", "window", "displays"], "prepared-window-after")
            need(r7.system_bar_content_geometry(after, image.size) == geometry, "main geometry changed during screenshot")
        r7.write_new(args.out / "prepared-window-after.txt", after.encode(), binary=True)
        l, t, r, b = geometry["content_rect"]
        x, y = report["start_point"]
        need(l <= x < r and t <= y < b, "Start point is outside observed app content")
        current = adb.app_json("files/control-session.json") or {}
        need(current == baseline and not r7.active(current), "task state changed during preparation")
        need(set(adb.list_children("files/runs", directories=True)) == baseline_runs
             and set(adb.list_children("files/control-tasks", directories=True)) == baseline_tasks, "preparation created a task or model run")
        need(adb.app_bytes("files/model/runtime-config.json") == config_raw, "runtime configuration changed")
        need(read_ui_preferences(adb, args.expected_uid, "prepared-choice-final") == preferences_raw,
             "explicit dual UI preferences changed during preparation")
        need(r7.package_identity(adb, PKG, "hepta-after") == hepta and r7.package_identity(adb, TARGET, "notes_target-after") == notes_target, "installed package identity changed")
        report.update(prepared=True, main_display_mapping=mapping, prepared_geometry=geometry,
            prepared_screen_sha256=sha(screen), prepared_window_sha256=sha(windows.encode()),
            background_notes_reviewed_start_arguments={"test_mode": args.test_mode, "target_package": TARGET, "start_tap": report["start_point"],
                "prepared_screen": str(args.out / "prepared-main.png"), "prepared_screen_sha256": sha(screen),
                "prepared_window_dump": str(args.out / "prepared-window.txt"), "prepared_window_dump_sha256": sha(windows.encode())},
            ordinary_owner_lock_handoff_required=True,
            handoff="Normally close the existing owner before the independent background Notes runner acquires the original operation_lock")
    finally:
        os.close(owner_fd)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--test-mode", choices=[MODE, "background_only"], required=True)
    for name in ("ui-helper", "background-driver", "r7-driver", "source-tools", "owner-root", "runtime-config", "plan", "out"):
        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=Path, required=True)

        parser.add_argument("--" + name, type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--command-timeout", type=int, default=12)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(isinstance(EXPECTED_V56_APK_SHA, str)
         and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", EXPECTED_V56_APK_SHA)
         and args.apk_sha256 == EXPECTED_V56_APK_SHA,
         "actual final v56 APK identity is not sealed; no phone execution")
    if args.test_mode == "background_only":
        need((str(args.plan), args.plan_sha256) in {
            ("/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/background-notes-adapters-v56-r1/notes-plan-cancel-r1.json", "ff3888e69651a7fc0f10740e10b49766c2234cf3cfd6056a617af838745ac292"),
            ("/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/background-notes-adapters-v56-r1/notes-plan-recovery-r1.json", "ac7f258399e5738baff01d9aa067433879355be33b7bec8926e87f61d13584e9"),
        }, "background-only preparation requires exact reviewed cancel or recovery plan")
    need(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", args.apk_sha256) and 10000 <= args.expected_uid < 90000
         and 1 <= args.adb_port <= 65535 and 1 <= args.command_timeout <= 30, "exact bounded device arguments required")
    need(args.out.is_absolute() and not args.out.exists() and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in args.out.parents), "new absolute output directory required")
    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
    report = {"schema": "hepta.ordinary-background-notes-ui-preparation.v1", "driver_revision": "notes-v56-dual-ui-comma-plan-r1",
        "test_mode": args.test_mode, "prepared": False, "task_started": False, "start_tapped": False,
        "target_app_operated": False, "existing_tasks_removed": False, "direct_broker_client_used": False,
        "permissions_changed": False, "r12_operation_lock_acquired_or_bypassed": False,
        "expected_apk_sha256": args.apk_sha256, "expected_uid": args.expected_uid,
        "started_wall_s": time.time()}
    try:
        execute(args, report)
    except Exception as error:
        report["prepared"] = False
        report["error"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
    finally:
        report["ended_wall_s"] = time.time()
        (args.out / "RESULT.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"prepared": report["prepared"], "error": report.get("error"), "blockers": report.get("blockers"), "result": str(args.out / "RESULT.json")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0 if report["prepared"] and report.get("error") is None else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def strict(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            need(key not in result, "duplicate JSON key")
            result[key] = value
        return result
    def bad(value):
        raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON: " + value)
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=bad)


def checked_file(path, maximum=8 << 20):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute() and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)),
         "absolute non-symlink input required: " + str(path))
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and 0 < before.st_size <= maximum, "invalid input size/type")
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    def key(s):
        return (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_size, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)
    need(len(raw) == before.st_size and key(before) == key(after) == key(path.stat()), "input changed while read")
    return raw


def write_new(path, value, binary=False):
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    need(all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), "output symlink refused")
    raw = value if binary else (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
    with os.fdopen(os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600), "wb") as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def load_pinned(name, path):
    need(name not in sys.modules, "preloaded helper refused: " + name)
    raw = checked_file(path)
    need(digest(raw) == PINS[name], "helper differs from reviewed bytes: " + name)
    module = ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__, module.__package__ = str(path), ""
    sys.modules[name] = module
    exec(compile(raw, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    return module


def load_action_binder(source_tools, acceptance, receipts):
    """Load the exact reviewed v38 suite's complete pure action binding closure."""
    path = source_tools / "phone_suite.py"
    raw = checked_file(path)
    need(digest(raw) == PINS["phone_suite"], "action binder source differs from reviewed v38 bytes")
    functions = {"_evidence_object", "_action_identity", "_collected_bytes", "_warm_task_model_binding",
        "model_action_binding", "_ime_submit_action_binding", "_submit_journal_identity"}
    constants = {"SHA", "PKG", "IME_SUBMIT_IDENTITY", "BACKGROUND_GENERATION"}
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    selected = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in functions
        or isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
        and node.targets[0].id in constants]
    found = {node.name if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) else node.targets[0].id for node in selected}
    need(found == functions | constants, "complete v38 pure action binding closure unavailable")
    namespace = {"acceptance": acceptance, "json": json, "Path": Path, "re": re,
        **{name: getattr(receipts, name) for name in ("APP_REQUEST", "NATIVE_REQUEST", "request_contract", "session_contract", "collection_verified")}}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=selected, type_ignores=[]), str(path) + ":pure-action-binding", "exec"), namespace)
    return namespace["model_action_binding"]






def text(adb, words, label, timeout=8):
    _, raw = adb.command(words, label=label, timeout=timeout)
    need(len(raw) <= 8 << 20, "system observation exceeded bound")
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="strict")


def bounded_private_reader(adb):
    """Keep collection bounded before bytes cross ADB, with the same guarded command."""
    def app_bytes(relative, *, optional=False):
        need(re.fullmatch(r"files/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+", relative) and ".." not in relative.split("/"),
             "unsafe private evidence path")
        parts = relative.split("/")
        paths = ["/".join(parts[:i]) for i in range(1, len(parts) + 1)]
        links = " || ".join("[ -L " + shlex.quote(p) + " ]" for p in paths)
        quoted = shlex.quote(relative)
        script = ("if " + links + "; then exit 41; fi; "
            "if [ ! -e " + quoted + " ]; then exit 40; fi; "
            "if [ ! -f " + quoted + " ]; then exit 41; fi; "
            "n=$(wc -c < " + quoted + ") || exit 42; "
            "case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 42;; esac; "
            "if [ \"$n\" -gt 16777216 ]; then exit 42; fi; head -c 16777217 " + quoted)
        code, raw = adb.command(["run-as", PACKAGE, "sh", "-c", script], label="bounded-app-evidence",
            allowed=(0, 40) if optional else (0,), raw=True)
        need(len(raw) <= 16 << 20, "private evidence grew beyond bound")
        return None if code == 40 else raw
    adb.app_bytes = app_bytes


def collect_exact_input_ids(adb, directory, collection):
    """Read only the fixed binary artifact for already-associated native runs.

    This separate diagnostic never changes collection.json, its verification
    flags, or business verdicts.  Actual bytes, rather than a copied native
    hash alone, are required for this diagnostic's byte-verification result.
    """
    directory = Path(directory)
    collection_path = directory / "collection.json"
    collection_raw = checked_file(collection_path)
    need(strict(collection_raw) == collection, "input-ID collector original collection differs")
    runs = collection.get("associated_runs")
    need(isinstance(runs, list), "associated native run list required")
    run_ids = [row.get("run_id") if isinstance(row, dict) else None for row in runs]
    need(all(isinstance(run, str) and HEX32.fullmatch(run) for run in run_ids)
         and len(set(run_ids)) == len(run_ids), "invalid or duplicate associated native run")
    result = {"schema": "hepta.input-ids-binary-collection.v1", "task_id": collection.get("task_id"),
        "original_collection_sha256": digest(collection_raw), "diagnostic_only": True,
        "business_verdict_unchanged": True, "original_collection_unchanged": False,
        "fixed_filename": "formatted-input-ids.le32", "runs": [],
        "all_associated_ids_bytes_verified": False,
        "scope": "Actual binary bytes compared with the collected native and prompt-evidence receipts; not a new model run, retokenization proof or business success."}
    for source in runs:
        run = source["run_id"]
        relative = "runs/" + run + "/formatted-input-ids.le32"
        row = {"run_id": run, "path": relative, "available": False, "bytes": None, "sha256": None,
            "encoding": "uint32-little-endian", "decoded_count": None, "checks": {},
            "actual_bytes_verified_against_native_receipt": False}
        result["runs"].append(row)
        try:
            raw = adb.app_bytes("files/" + relative, optional=True)
            if raw is None:
                row["missing"] = "fixed binary artifact absent"
                continue
            need(isinstance(raw, bytes) and len(raw) <= 16 << 20, "invalid or oversized input-ID bytes")
            write_new(directory / relative, raw, binary=True)
            row.update(available=True, bytes=len(raw), sha256=digest(raw))
            aligned = len(raw) > 0 and len(raw) % 4 == 0
            count = len(raw) // 4 if aligned else None
            row["decoded_count"] = count

            def bound_json(name):
                path = "runs/" + run + "/" + name
                entries = [entry for entry in source.get("files", []) if entry.get("path") == path]
                need(len(entries) == 1, "one original collection entry required: " + name)
                value = checked_file(directory / path)
                need(len(value) == entries[0].get("bytes") and digest(value) == entries[0].get("sha256"),
                     "original collected receipt bytes differ: " + name)
                row[name] = {"path": path, "bytes": len(value), "sha256": digest(value)}
                parsed = strict(value)
                need(isinstance(parsed, dict), "collected receipt is not an object")
                return parsed

            native, meta = bound_json("native-result.json"), bound_json("prompt-evidence.json")
            budget = native.get("prompt_budget", {})
            profile = native.get("profile", {})
            need(isinstance(budget, dict) and isinstance(profile, dict), "native budget/profile is not an object")
            row["native_budget_fields"] = {key: budget.get(key) for key in (
                "method", "is_exact_token_count", "model_contract_sha256", "input_ids_count",
                "prompt_tokens_exact", "input_ids_sha256", "input_ids_passed_directly")}
            row["prompt_evidence_fields"] = {key: meta.get(key) for key in (
                "schema", "request_id", "model_profile", "model_sha256", "input_ids_count", "input_ids_bytes",
                "input_ids_encoding", "input_ids_sha256", "input_ids_will_be_passed_directly")}
            row["sdk_prompt_tokens"] = profile.get("prompt_tokens")
            row["checks"] = {
                "nonempty_aligned_le32": aligned,
                "native_request_id": native.get("request_id") == run,
                "metadata_request_id": meta.get("request_id") == run and meta.get("schema") == "hepta.private-prompt-evidence.v1",
                "metadata_encoding": meta.get("input_ids_encoding") == "uint32-little-endian",
                "actual_sha_matches_native_budget": row["sha256"] == budget.get("input_ids_sha256"),
                "actual_sha_matches_prompt_evidence": row["sha256"] == meta.get("input_ids_sha256"),
                "actual_bytes_match_prompt_evidence": type(meta.get("input_ids_bytes")) is int and len(raw) == meta["input_ids_bytes"],
                "actual_count_matches_native_budget": aligned and type(budget.get("input_ids_count")) is int
                    and type(budget.get("prompt_tokens_exact")) is int and count == budget["input_ids_count"] == budget["prompt_tokens_exact"],
                "actual_count_matches_prompt_evidence": aligned and type(meta.get("input_ids_count")) is int and count == meta["input_ids_count"],
                "actual_count_matches_sdk_prompt_tokens": aligned and type(profile.get("prompt_tokens")) is int and count == profile["prompt_tokens"],
                "exact_same_ids_contract": budget.get("method") == "llama_tokenize_exact_same_input_ids"
                    and budget.get("is_exact_token_count") is True and budget.get("input_ids_passed_directly") is True
                    and meta.get("input_ids_will_be_passed_directly") is True,
            }
            row["actual_bytes_verified_against_native_receipt"] = all(row["checks"].values())
        except Exception as error:
            row["error"] = type(error).__name__ + ": " + str(error)
    need(checked_file(collection_path) == collection_raw and strict(collection_raw) == collection,
         "original collection changed during binary read")
    result["original_collection_unchanged"] = True
    result["all_associated_ids_bytes_verified"] = bool(result["runs"]) and all(
        row["actual_bytes_verified_against_native_receipt"] is True for row in result["runs"])
    write_new(directory / "input-ids-binary-collection.json", result)
    return result


def package_identity(adb, package, label):
    raw = text(adb, ["cmd", "package", "list", "packages", "-U", package], label + "-uid")
    found = re.findall(r"^package:" + re.escape(package) + r" uid:(\d+)\s*$", raw, re.M)
    need(len(found) == 1, "exact package UID unavailable: " + package)
    paths = text(adb, ["pm", "path", package], label + "-paths").splitlines()
    need(paths and len(paths) <= 32 and all(p.startswith("package:/data/app/") or p.startswith("package:/system/")
         or p.startswith("package:/product/") or p.startswith("package:/system_ext/") for p in paths), "unrecognized APK path")
    apks = []
    for index, line in enumerate(paths):
        path = line[len("package:"):]
        need(path.endswith(".apk") and "\n" not in path, "invalid APK path")
        hashed = text(adb, ["sha256sum", path], label + "-apk-" + str(index)).strip()
        match = re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})\s+(.+)", hashed)
        need(match is not None and match.group(2) == path, "APK digest output differs")
        apks.append({"path": path, "sha256": match.group(1)})
    return {"package": package, "uid": int(found[0]), "apks": sorted(apks, key=lambda x: x["path"])}


def parse_displays(raw):
    rows = {}
    for match in re.finditer(r"^\s*Display id (\d+):\s*(.+)$", raw, re.M):
        number, description = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2)
        need(number not in rows, "duplicate display enumeration")
        name = re.search(r'DisplayInfo\{"([^"]+)"', description)
        need(name is not None, "display name unavailable")
        rows[number] = {"name": name.group(1), "description": description}
    need(0 in rows, "unsupported cmd display get-displays format; no empty-set fallback")
    return rows


def display_blocks(raw, pattern):
    headings = list(re.finditer(pattern, raw, re.M))
    need(headings, "system display headings unavailable")
    result = {}
    for index, heading in enumerate(headings):
        number = int(heading.group(1))
        need(number not in result, "ambiguous display heading")
        result[number] = raw[heading.end():headings[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(headings) else len(raw)]
    need(0 in result, "main display absent from system dump")
    return result


def png_rgba(raw):
    """Decode one bounded PNG without resizing, tolerance, alpha masking or OCR."""
    need(isinstance(raw, bytes) and raw.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") and len(raw) <= 16 << 20,
         "Start proof must be a bounded original PNG")
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as image:
        need(image.format == "PNG" and getattr(image, "n_frames", 1) == 1, "single-frame PNG required")
        width, height = image.size
        need(1 <= width <= 10000 and 1 <= height <= 10000 and width * height <= 16000000,
             "Start proof dimensions exceed bound")
        image.load()
        return image.convert("RGBA")


def main_physical_display_mapping(display_dump, surfaceflinger_dump, physical_id):
    """Bind explicit screencap physical ID to logical 0 using two system dumps.

    Only the observed Logical Displays section spelling is supported. HWC
    display numbers are recorded, never treated as Android logical IDs.
    """
    need(isinstance(physical_id, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]{0,19}", physical_id)
         and int(physical_id) < 1 << 64, "canonical unsigned physical display ID required")
    headings = list(re.finditer(r"^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)Logical Displays: size=(?P<count>\d+)[ \t]*$", display_dump, re.M))
    need(len(headings) == 1, "unique Logical Displays section required")
    heading = headings[0]
    tail = display_dump[heading.end():]
    end = re.search(r"^" + re.escape(heading.group("indent")) + r"Display Groups: size=\d+[ \t]*$", tail, re.M)
    need(end is not None, "Logical Displays section boundary unavailable")
    section = tail[:end.start()]
    entries = list(re.finditer(r"^" + re.escape(heading.group("indent")) + r"Display (\d+):[ \t]*$", section, re.M))
    need(len(entries) == int(heading.group("count")) and entries, "Logical Displays count/entries differ")
    blocks = {}
    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        number = int(entry.group(1))
        need(number not in blocks, "duplicate logical display entry")
        blocks[number] = section[entry.end():entries[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(entries) else len(section)]
    need(0 in blocks, "logical main display 0 absent")
    block = blocks[0]
    def field(name):
        values = re.findall(r"^[ \t]+" + re.escape(name) + r"=([^\n]*)$", block, re.M)
        need(len(values) == 1, "unique logical-0 field required: " + name)
        return values[0].strip()
    need(field("mDisplayId") == "0" and field("mLayerStack") == "0", "main display identity/layer differs")
    need(field("mIsEnabled") == "true" and field("mIsInTransition") == "false", "main display disabled or transitioning")
    need(field("mDisplayOffset") == "(0, 0)", "main display offset is not covered")
    primary = re.fullmatch(r".+\(local:([1-9][0-9]{0,19})\)", field("mPrimaryDisplayDevice"))
    need(primary is not None and primary.group(1) == physical_id, "requested physical display is not logical 0 primary device")
    infos = []
    for name in ("mBaseDisplayInfo", "mOverrideDisplayInfo"):
        value = field(name)
        need(value.startswith('DisplayInfo{"') and value.endswith("}"), "non-null supported DisplayInfo required")
        def token(pattern, label):
            matches = re.findall(r"(?:^|, )" + pattern + r"(?=, |\}$)", value)
            need(len(matches) == 1, "unique DisplayInfo token required: " + label)
            return matches[0]
        need(token(r"displayId (\d+)", "displayId") == "0"
             and token(r'uniqueId "local:(\d+)"', "uniqueId") == physical_id,
             "DisplayInfo logical/physical mapping differs")
        size = tuple(map(int, token(r"real (\d+) x (\d+)", "real dimensions")))
        need(all(1 <= value <= 10000 for value in size) and size[0] * size[1] <= 16000000,
             "DisplayInfo dimensions exceed PNG bound")
        need(token(r"rotation (\d+)", "rotation") == "0", "only observed natural rotation 0 is covered")
        need(token(r"state ([A-Z_]+)", "state") == "ON"
             and token(r"committedState ([A-Z_]+)", "committedState") == "ON", "main display is not fully ON")
        need(token(r"type ([A-Z_]+)", "type") == "INTERNAL"
             and token(r"layerStack (\d+)", "layerStack") == "0", "main display type/layer differs")
        infos.append(size)
    need(infos[0] == infos[1], "base/override main display dimensions differ")
    physical = {}
    for line in surfaceflinger_dump.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Display ([1-9][0-9]{0,19}) \(HWC display (\d+)\): port=(\d+) pnpId=([A-Za-z0-9]+) displayName="[^"\n]*"', line.strip())
        need(match is not None, "unsupported SurfaceFlinger physical-display format")
        number = match.group(1)
        need(int(number) < 1 << 64 and number not in physical, "invalid/duplicate SurfaceFlinger physical display")
        physical[number] = {"physical_display_id": number, "hwc_display_id": int(match.group(2)), "port": int(match.group(3))}
    need(physical_id in physical, "logical-0 physical display absent from SurfaceFlinger")
    return {"verified": True, "logical_display_id": 0, **physical[physical_id],
        "screen_size": list(infos[0]), "rotation": 0,
        "display_dump_sha256": digest(display_dump.encode("utf-8")),
        "surfaceflinger_dump_sha256": digest(surfaceflinger_dump.encode("utf-8")),
        "claim_scope": "fresh sequential system logical-0 primary/base/override and SurfaceFlinger physical-ID match; HWC ID is not assumed logical"}


def system_bar_content_geometry(raw, size, focus_package=PACKAGE):
    """Use only display 0's global InsetsState dump, never caller-selected crops.

    This intentionally supports the reviewed AOSP dump format only. An unknown
    vendor layout, multiple source/controller sections or side bars is rejected.
    InsetsStateController's source frames are system observations, not an atomic
    screenshot transaction or an attestation of what the operator reviewed.
    """
    width, height = size
    block = display_blocks(raw, r"^\s*Display: mDisplayId=(\d+)\b[^\n]*$")[0]
    focus = re.findall(r"^\s*mCurrentFocus=(.+)$", block, re.M)
    need(len(focus) == 1 and re.fullmatch(r"Window\{[0-9a-f]+ u0 " + re.escape(focus_package) + r"/[^{}\s]+\}", focus[0].strip()),
         "exact expected app must be focused on display 0")
    headings = list(re.finditer(r"^[ \t]*WindowInsetsStateController[ \t]*$", block, re.M))
    need(len(headings) == 1, "unique display-0 InsetsStateController required; no guessed crop")
    tail = block[headings[0].end():]
    end = re.search(r"^[ \t]*Control map:[ \t]*$", tail, re.M)
    need(end is not None, "InsetsState source section boundary unavailable")
    source_block = tail[:end.start()]
    need(len(re.findall(r"^[ \t]*InsetsState[ \t]*$", source_block, re.M)) == 1,
         "unique global InsetsState required")
    frames = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*mDisplayFrame=Rect\(\s*(-?\d+),\s*(-?\d+)\s*-\s*(-?\d+),\s*(-?\d+)\s*\)[ \t]*$",
        source_block, re.M)
    need(len(frames) == 1 and tuple(map(int, frames[0])) == (0, 0, width, height),
         "InsetsState display frame differs from original screenshot dimensions")
    source_lines = [line.strip() for line in source_block.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("InsetsSource")]
    need(source_lines, "InsetsState contains no readable sources")
    pattern = re.compile(r"InsetsSource id=([0-9a-fA-F]+)(?: #[0-9a-fA-F]+)? type=([A-Za-z]+) "
        r"frame=\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]"
        r"(?: visibleFrame=\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\]\[(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\])?"
        r" visible=(true|false)(?:[ \t]+.*)?")
    sources, seen = [], set()
    for line in source_lines:
        match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
        need(match is not None, "unsupported InsetsSource dump format; no guessed crop")
        identifier, kind = match.group(1, 2)
        need(identifier not in seen, "duplicate global InsetsSource id")
        seen.add(identifier)
        frame = tuple(map(int, match.group(3, 4, 5, 6)))
        visible_frame = tuple(map(int, match.group(7, 8, 9, 10))) if match.group(7) is not None else None
        visible = match.group(11) == "true"
        need(not (kind == "ime" and visible), "hide the keyboard through normal preparation before Start proof")
        if kind in ("statusBars", "navigationBars"):
            need(visible_frame is None or visible_frame == frame, "partial visible system-bar frame is not supported")
            sources.append({"type": kind, "source_id": identifier, "frame": list(frame), "visible": visible})
    need(len(sources) == 2 and {row["type"] for row in sources} == {"statusBars", "navigationBars"},
         "exactly one statusBars and one navigationBars source required")
    bars = {row["type"]: row for row in sources}
    top, bottom = 0, height
    for kind, row in bars.items():
        if not row["visible"]:
            continue  # A hidden system bar grants no excluded pixels.
        left, first, right, last = row["frame"]
        need(left == 0 and right == width and 0 <= first < last <= height,
             "only full-width horizontal system bars may be excluded")
        need(last - first <= height // 8, "system bar is implausibly tall; no broad crop permitted")
        if kind == "statusBars":
            need(first == 0, "status bar must touch the top display edge")
            top = last
        else:
            need(last == height, "navigation bar must touch the bottom display edge")
            bottom = first
    need(top < bottom, "system bars leave no application content")
    return {"display_id": 0, "screen_size": [width, height], "content_rect": [0, top, width, bottom],
        "main_focus": focus[0].strip(), "system_bars": [bars[kind] for kind in ("statusBars", "navigationBars")],
        "geometry_source": "display0.WindowInsetsStateController.InsetsState"}


def compare_start_content(reviewed_png, current_png, reviewed_windows, current_windows, coordinates):
    """Require exact decoded RGBA pixels across all content outside system bars."""
    with png_rgba(reviewed_png) as reviewed, png_rgba(current_png) as current:
        need(reviewed.size == current.size, "Start screenshot dimensions/rotation changed")
        reference = system_bar_content_geometry(reviewed_windows, reviewed.size)
        fresh = system_bar_content_geometry(current_windows, current.size)
        reference_mask = [(row["type"], row["frame"], row["visible"]) for row in reference["system_bars"]]
        current_mask = [(row["type"], row["frame"], row["visible"]) for row in fresh["system_bars"]]
        need(reference_mask == current_mask and reference["content_rect"] == fresh["content_rect"],
             "system-bar geometry/visibility changed since review")
        rect = fresh["content_rect"]
        x, y = coordinates
        need(rect[0] <= x < rect[2] and rect[1] <= y < rect[3], "Start coordinates are outside compared application content")
        with reviewed.crop(rect) as before, current.crop(rect) as after:
            reviewed_pixels, current_pixels = before.tobytes(), after.tobytes()
        return {"algorithm": "exact_decoded_RGBA_pixels_outside_system_bars_v1",
            "pixels_equal": reviewed_pixels == current_pixels,
            "reviewed_content_rgba_sha256": digest(reviewed_pixels), "current_content_rgba_sha256": digest(current_pixels),
            "reviewed_png_sha256": digest(reviewed_png), "current_png_sha256": digest(current_png),

def formal_accessibility_bound(accessibility):
    expected = PACKAGE + "/" + PACKAGE + ".HeptaAccessibilityService"
    sections = re.findall(r"\bBound services:\{(.*?)\}\s*Enabled services:\{", accessibility, re.S)
    return any(re.search(re.escape(name) + r"(?=[,\]\s}])", section)
        for section in sections for name in (expected, PACKAGE + "/.HeptaAccessibilityService"))


def indented_record_body(raw, heading):
    """Stop before the next peer/outer section, including historical connections."""
    indent = len(heading.group("indent").expandtabs(8))
    tail = raw[heading.end():]
    offset = 0
    for line in tail.splitlines(keepends=True):
        if line.strip() and len(line[:len(line) - len(line.lstrip())].expandtabs(8)) <= indent:
            return tail[:offset]
        offset += len(line)
    return tail


def formal_service_binding(services, expected_uid):
    """Attest the exact ordinary service via AMS, never a non-unique UI label.

    A Motorola AccessibilityManager dump may only name labels in Bound services.
    This alternative demands the exact active ServiceRecord, binder delivery,
    hasBound, the ordinary process UID and a live system/1000 client connection.
    """
    need(type(expected_uid) is int and 10000 <= expected_uid < 90000, "ordinary service UID required")
    names = {PACKAGE + "/.HeptaAccessibilityService", PACKAGE + "/" + PACKAGE + ".HeptaAccessibilityService"}
    headings = list(re.finditer(r"^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)\* ServiceRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ u(?P<user>\d+) "
        r"(?P<component>[^\s}]+)(?: [^}\n]*)?\}[ \t]*$", services, re.M))
    matching = [heading for heading in headings if heading.group("user") == "0" and heading.group("component") in names]
    need(len(matching) == 1, "unique exact active formal Hepta ServiceRecord required")
    heading = matching[0]
    body = indented_record_body(services, heading)
    for field, expected in (("packageName", PACKAGE), ("processName", PACKAGE),
                            ("permission", "android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE")):
        values = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*" + field + r"=([^\n]+)$", body, re.M)
        need(values == [expected], "formal service " + field + " differs/ambiguous")
    processes = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*app=ProcessRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ (\d+):" + re.escape(PACKAGE)
        + r"/u0a(\d+)\}[ \t]*$", body, re.M)
    need(len(processes) == 1 and int(processes[0][0]) > 0 and 10000 + int(processes[0][1]) == expected_uid,
         "formal service process not bound to exact ordinary UID")
    bindings = list(re.finditer(r"^(?P<indent>[ \t]*)\* IntentBindRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ CREATE\}:[ \t]*$", body, re.M))
    need(len(bindings) == 1, "unique formal service binding required")
    binding = indented_record_body(body, bindings[0])
    intents = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*intent=\{cmp=([^\s}]+)\}[ \t]*$", binding, re.M)
    need(len(intents) == 1 and intents[0] in names, "binding intent is not the exact formal component")
    need(len(re.findall(r"^[ \t]*binder=android\.os\.BinderProxy@[0-9a-f]+[ \t]*$", binding, re.M)) == 1,
         "formal service has no delivered binder")
    states = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*requested=(true|false) received=(true|false) hasBound=(true|false) doRebind=(true|false)[ \t]*$",
        binding, re.M)
    need(states == [("true", "true", "true", "false")], "formal service bind is not fully received and active")
    clients = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*\* Client AppBindRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ ProcessRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ (\d+):system/1000\}\}[ \t]*$",
        binding, re.M)
    need(len(clients) == 1 and int(clients[0]) > 0
        and len(re.findall(r"^[ \t]*\* Client AppBindRecord\{", binding, re.M)) == 1,
        "formal service binding lacks unique system/1000 client")
    connections = re.findall(r"^[ \t]*ConnectionRecord\{([0-9a-f]+) u0 ([^\n{}]+)\}[ \t]*$", binding, re.M)
    need(connections, "formal service has no system-client connection")
    for _, fields in connections:
        need("DEAD" not in fields.split(), "formal service current binding is DEAD")
        component = re.findall(r"(?:^|\s)([^\s:]+):@[0-9a-f]+ flags=0x[0-9a-f]+$", fields)
        need(len(component) == 1 and component[0] in names, "formal service connection component differs")
    return {"verified": True, "component": PACKAGE + "/" + PACKAGE + ".HeptaAccessibilityService",
        "app_pid": int(processes[0][0]), "app_uid": expected_uid, "client_pid": int(clients[0]), "client_uid": 1000,
        "binder_received": True, "has_bound": True, "connection_ids": sorted({item[0] for item in connections}),
        "service_dump_sha256": digest(services.encode("utf-8")),
        "identity_scope": "exact active AMS ServiceRecord and live system-client binding; label-only AccessibilityManager rows are not component attestation"}


def activity_task_inventory(raw, target):
    """Read only the bounded live Task/Hist enumeration, not supervisor history.

    A stopped or hidden activity still counts as an existing task. Every Hist
    record must belong to its enclosing Task ID. Unknown headings fail closed.
    """
    need(isinstance(raw, str) and isinstance(target, str)
         and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)+", target),
         "activity dump and exact target package required")
    need(len(re.findall(r"^ACTIVITY MANAGER ACTIVITIES \(dumpsys activity activities\)$", raw, re.M)) == 1,
         "supported activity enumeration header required")
    headings = list(re.finditer(r"^Display #(\d+) \(activities from top to bottom\):[ \t]*$", raw, re.M))
    need(headings and len(headings) == len(re.findall(r"^Display #", raw, re.M)),
         "unknown activity display heading")
    displays, records, task_ids = [], [], set()
    task_pattern = re.compile(r"(?P<indent> +)\* Task\{[0-9a-f]+ #(?P<id>\d+) (?P<attributes>[^{}\r\n]+)\}")
    # This device also emits a finishing ActivityRecord with the exact suffix " f}}".
    # Keep that live Hist record in its enclosing task; finishing is not task absence.
    hist_pattern = re.compile(r"(?P<indent> +)\* Hist[ \t]+#(?P<index>\d+): ActivityRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ "
        r"u(?P<user>\d+) (?P<component>[^\s{}]+/[^\s{}]+) t(?P<task>\d+)(?:(?: [^{}\r\n]*)?\}| f\}\})")
    for index, heading in enumerate(headings):
        display_id = int(heading.group(1))
        need(display_id not in displays, "duplicate activity display enumeration")
        displays.append(display_id)
        tail = raw[heading.end():headings[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(headings) else len(raw)]
        ends = list(re.finditer(r"^  Resumed activities in task display areas \(from top to bottom\):[ \t]*$", tail, re.M))
        need(len(ends) == 1, "unique task enumeration end boundary required")
        section, stack = tail[:ends[0].start()], []
        for line in section.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith("* Task{"):
                match = task_pattern.fullmatch(line)
                need(match is not None, "unsupported live Task header")
                task_id, indent = int(match.group("id")), len(match.group("indent"))
                need(task_id not in task_ids, "duplicate live Task ID across displays")
                task_ids.add(task_id)
                while stack and stack[-1][0] >= indent:
                    stack.pop()
                attrs = match.group("attributes")
                affinity = re.findall(r"(?:^| )A=([^ ]+)(?= |$)", attrs)
                intent = re.findall(r"(?:^| )I=([^ ]+)(?= |$)", attrs)
                need(len(affinity) <= 1 and len(intent) <= 1, "ambiguous Task identity fields")
                affinity = affinity[0] if affinity else None
                intent = intent[0] if intent else None
                affinity_package = re.sub(r"^\d+:", "", affinity) if affinity is not None else None
                row = {"display_id": display_id, "task_id": task_id,
                    "parent_task_id": stack[-1][1]["task_id"] if stack else None,
                    "affinity": affinity, "intent_component": intent, "activities": [],
                    "target_in_task_header": affinity_package == target
                        or intent is not None and intent.split("/", 1)[0] == target}
                records.append(row)
                stack.append((indent, row))
            elif stripped.startswith("* Hist"):
                match = hist_pattern.fullmatch(line)
                need(match is not None, "unsupported live Hist record")
                indent = len(match.group("indent"))
                while stack and stack[-1][0] >= indent:
                    stack.pop()
                need(stack and stack[-1][1]["task_id"] == int(match.group("task")),
                     "Hist record is outside its exact enclosing Task")
                row = stack[-1][1]
                hist_index = int(match.group("index"))
                need(hist_index not in {a["history_index"] for a in row["activities"]}, "duplicate Hist index")
                component = match.group("component")
                row["activities"].append({"history_index": hist_index, "user_id": int(match.group("user")),
                    "component": component, "package": component.split("/", 1)[0]})
            elif stripped.startswith("* ActivityRecord{"):
                raise RuntimeError("unrecognized live ActivityRecord form outside Hist enumeration")
    need(0 in displays, "main activity display absent")
    matched = [row for row in records if row["target_in_task_header"]
               or any(activity["package"] == target for activity in row["activities"])]
    return {"schema": "hepta.actual-task-display-enumeration.v1", "target_package": target,
        "display_ids": sorted(displays), "target_task_displays": sorted({row["display_id"] for row in matched}),
        "target_tasks": matched, "enumerated_task_count": len(records),
        "enumerated_activity_count": sum(len(row["activities"]) for row in records),
        "activity_dump_sha256": digest(raw.encode()),
        "claim_scope": "actual Task headers and enclosed Hist records before each display's Resumed activities boundary; orientation/supervisor references do not create tasks"}


def system_snapshot(adb, directory, index, target, phase="hepta"):
    started = time.monotonic()
    displays_raw = text(adb, ["cmd", "display", "get-displays"], "displays")
    windows_raw = text(adb, ["dumpsys", "window", "displays"], "window-displays")
    inputs_raw = text(adb, ["dumpsys", "input"], "input-dispatcher")
    tasks_raw = text(adb, ["dumpsys", "activity", "activities"], "activity-displays")
    processes_raw = text(adb, ["ps", "-A", "-o", "UID,PID,PPID,ARGS"], "process-uid")
    row = {"index": index, "main_user_phase": phase, "started_monotonic_s": started, "ended_monotonic_s": time.monotonic(), "errors": []}
    try:
        row["displays"] = parse_displays(displays_raw)
        windows = display_blocks(windows_raw, r"^\s*Display: mDisplayId=(\d+)\b[^\n]*$")
        focus = re.findall(r"^\s*mCurrentFocus=(.+)$", windows[0], re.M)
        focused_display = re.findall(r"^\s*FocusedDisplayId:\s*(\d+)\s*$", inputs_raw, re.M)
        need(len(focus) == 1 and len(focused_display) == 1, "focus observation unavailable/ambiguous")
        row.update(main_focus=focus[0].strip(), input_focused_display=int(focused_display[0]))
        row["main_focus_context"] = MAIN_INFLIGHT.focus_context(windows_raw, inputs_raw)
        tasks = activity_task_inventory(tasks_raw, target)
        row["target_task_displays"] = tasks["target_task_displays"]
        row["task_display_ids"] = tasks["display_ids"]
        row["activity_task_inventory"] = tasks
        processes = []
        for line in processes_raw.splitlines()[1:]:
            fields = line.split(None, 3)
            need(len(fields) == 4 and all(v.isdigit() for v in fields[:3]), "unsupported numeric ps format")
            processes.append({"uid": int(fields[0]), "pid": int(fields[1]), "ppid": int(fields[2]), "args": fields[3]})
        row["processes"] = processes
    except Exception as error:
        row["errors"].append(str(error))
    write_new(directory / "system" / ("sample-%04d.json" % index), row)
    return row
