        source=meta.get('source_input_sha256') or {}
        need(source.get('prompt')==digest(raw('prompt')) and source.get('grammar')==digest(raw('grammar'))
             and source.get('system')==digest(raw('system')) and source.get('image') is None,
             'complete live prompt/system/grammar hashes differ')
        out['input_identity']={'meta_sha256':digest(raw('input_meta')),'ids_sha256':digest(ids),
            'ids_bytes':len(ids),'input_count':meta['input_ids_count'],'prompt_sha256':digest(raw('prompt'))}
        if rows['workflow_grant']['mode']=='F':
            grant=obj('workflow_grant');parent=obj('parent_action');created=obj('parent_after')
            fixed=parent.get('fixed_intent') or {};action=parent.get('action') or {}
            need(grant.get('schema')=='hepta.notes-create-workflow.v1' and grant.get('task_id')==spec['task_id']
                 and grant.get('parent_step')==1 and type(grant.get('parent_step')) is int
                 and grant.get('parent_model_run_id')==spec['run_id'] and grant.get('parent_observation_id')==before['observation_id']
                 and grant.get('created_observation_id')==created.get('observation_id')
                 and grant.get('owner_sha256')==digest(owner.encode()) and grant.get('grant_consumed') is True
                 and grant.get('task_authorization_sha256')==original_owner.get('task_authorization_sha256')
                 and HEX64.fullmatch(grant.get('task_authorization_sha256') or '')
                 and grant.get('contract_sha256')==original_owner.get('completion_contract',{}).get('contract_sha256')
                 and grant.get('body_sha256')==original_owner.get('completion_contract',{}).get('expected_body_sha256')
                 and grant.get('grant_retired') is False and grant.get('grants_tool_authority') is False
                 and grant.get('display_id')==display_id and grant.get('background_generation')==background_generation
                 and grant.get('target_package')==NOTES,'current parent workflow grant differs')
            need(parent.get('model_issued') is True and parent.get('model_run_id')==spec['run_id']
                 and parent.get('accepted') is True and parent.get('dispatched') is True and parent.get('stale') is False
                 and action.get('action')=='notes.create' and action.get('package')==NOTES
                 and action.get('text')==context.get('body') and isinstance(context.get('body'),str)
                 and bool(context['body'])
                 and action.get('observation_id')==before['observation_id']
                 and fixed.get('task_id')==spec['task_id'] and fixed.get('model_run_id')==spec['run_id']
                 and fixed.get('attempt_id')==grant.get('parent_fixed_intent_attempt_id')
                 and fixed.get('payload_sha256')==grant.get('body_sha256')==digest(action.get('text','').encode())
                 and fixed.get('api_accepted') is True and fixed.get('dispatch_attempted') is True,

                 and len(apks)==1 and HEX64.fullmatch(apks[0].get('sha256') or '')
                 and grant.get('target_apk_sha256')=={'base':apks[0]['sha256']}
                 and created.get('package')==NOTES and created.get('window',{}).get('display_id')==display_id
                 and created.get('background_session',{}).get('generation')==background_generation
                 and created.get('background_session',{}).get('display_id')==display_id
                 and created.get('nodes_truncated') is False,
                 'created frame/installed identity differs')
            need(HEX64.fullmatch(grant.get('contract_sha256','')) and grant.get('workflow_id')==digest(
                 (spec['task_id']+'|'+spec['run_id']+'|'+fixed['attempt_id']+'|'+grant['contract_sha256']).encode()),
                 'workflow identity hash differs')
            need(all(rows[k]['mode']=='M' for k in ('workflow_result','workflow_abort')),
                 'tool workflow already returned/aborted')
            need(all(rows[k]['mode']=='P' for k in ('native_result','native_text','app_result')),
                 'workflow parent native result not yet durably available')
            out.update(eligible=True,phase='tool_workflow_inflight',workflow_id=grant['workflow_id'],
                grant_sha256=digest(raw('workflow_grant')),parent_action_sha256=digest(raw('parent_action')),
                parent_body_observation_id=created.get('observation_id'),
                parent_full_native_and_body_proof_pending_terminal_replay=True)
        else:
            need(all(rows[k]['mode']=='M' for k in ('native_result','native_text','app_result','parent_action',
                                                   'workflow_result','workflow_abort')),
                 'first native request is no longer in flight')
            log=raw('sdk_log');events=list(FORMATTED_GENERATE.finditer(log))
            need(len(events)==1 and tuple(map(int,events[0].groups()))==(0,meta['input_ids_count'],0),
                 'unique actual first SDK generate entry for this input count not observed')
            out.update(eligible=True,phase='native_request_entered_generate',
                sdk_generate_event=events[0].group().decode('ascii'),sdk_log_segment_sha256=digest(log),
                sdk_log_segment_offset=rows['sdk_log']['offset'],sdk_log_observed_bytes=rows['sdk_log']['total_bytes'])
        out['reason']='same task work in flight; final receipts/effect proof still required'
    except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,UnicodeError,AttributeError) as error:
        out['missing']=str(error)
    return out


def capture(adb, helpers, spec, context, directory, label):
    """One read-only command through the caller's existing lock/owner guard."""
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}',label),'bounded unique capture label required')
    script=read_script(spec)
    started=time.monotonic()
    _,raw=adb.command(['sh','-c',script],label='live-work-'+label,raw=True,timeout=3)
    returned=time.monotonic()
    rows=parse_stream(raw,spec)
    target=Path(directory)/'main-user'/'live-work'/label
    helpers.write_new(target/'stream.bin',raw,binary=True)
    proof=evaluate(rows,spec,context)
    inventory=[]
    for key,row in rows.items():
        saved=dict(row);data=saved.pop('raw');saved.update(name=key,sha256=digest(data))
        if row['mode']=='F':helpers.write_new(target/(key+'.bin'),data,binary=True)
        inventory.append(saved)
    proof.update(stream_sha256=digest(raw),stream_bytes=len(raw),records=inventory,
        script_sha256=digest(script.encode()),relative_capture='main-user/live-work/'+label,
        host_read_started_monotonic_s=started,host_read_returned_monotonic_s=returned)
    helpers.write_new(target/'proof.json',proof)
    return proof

"""New v51 main-user protocol, separate from the unchanged v50 failed case.

One ordinary Settings launch, bounded read-only readiness observation and at
most one display-0 swipe. No target-app input, task extension, launch retry,
UiAutomation, permission change or blanket success is implemented here.
"""
import json
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import time

SETTINGS='com.android.settings'
READY=re.compile(r'Window\{([0-9a-f]+) u0 (com\.android\.settings/[^{}\s]+)\}\Z')
SETTLE_SECONDS=3.0
FRESH_READ_SECONDS=1.0
PROTOCOL='same_task_native_or_tool_workflow_inflight.v1'


def need(ok,message):
    if not ok:raise RuntimeError(message)


def focus_context(windows,inputs):
    heads=list(re.finditer(r'^\s*Display: mDisplayId=([0-9]+)\b[^\n]*$',windows,re.M))
    blocks={}
    for i,m in enumerate(heads):
        key=int(m[1]);need(key not in blocks,'duplicate display window section')
        blocks[key]=windows[m.end():heads[i+1].start() if i+1<len(heads) else len(windows)]
    need(0 in blocks,'main display window section missing')
    main=blocks[0]
    def single(pattern,text):
        rows=re.findall(pattern,text,re.M);need(len(rows)==1,'ambiguous window/input field');return rows[0]
    current=single(r'^\s*mCurrentFocus=(.+)$',main).strip()
    app=single(r'^\s*mFocusedApp=(.+)$',main).strip()
    global_display=int(single(r'^\s*FocusedDisplayId:\s*([0-9]+)\s*$',inputs))
    section=re.findall(r'^  FocusedWindows:\n(.*?)(?=^  \S)',inputs,re.M|re.S)
    need(len(section)==1,'unique input focused-window section required')
    focused={}
    for display,name in re.findall(r"^    displayId=([0-9]+), name='([^']*)'\s*$",section[0],re.M):
        key=int(display);need(key not in focused,'duplicate focused input display');focused[key]=name
    return {'display_id':0,'main_focus':current,'main_focused_app':app,'input_focused_display':global_display,
        'input_window_display0':focused.get(0),'awake_and_fully_on':bool(re.search(
            r'mAwake=true mScreenOnEarly=true mScreenOnFully=true',main)),
        'settings_splash_observed':'Splash Screen com.android.settings' in main,
        'source':'actual same system sample window-displays and input stdout; sequential not atomic'}


def ready(context):
    match=READY.fullmatch(context.get('main_focus',''))
    return bool(match and context.get('input_focused_display')==0
        and context.get('input_window_display0')==match[1]+' '+match[2]
        and context.get('awake_and_fully_on') is True)


def transition(context):
    """Only an actually observed Settings launch context, never any null focus."""
    if ready(context):return True
    return bool(context.get('main_focus')=='null' and context.get('input_focused_display')==0
        and context.get('input_window_display0') is None and context.get('awake_and_fully_on') is True
        and re.fullmatch(r'ActivityRecord\{[0-9a-f]+ u0 com\.android\.settings/[^{}\s]+ t[0-9]+\}',
                         context.get('main_focused_app','')))


def fence_clock(proof,which):
    value=dict(proof.get(which+'_clock') or {})
    value['boot_id']=proof.get('boot_id');return value


def require_fresh(proof):
    need(proof.get('eligible') is True,'actual native request/workflow ended or is unproven before main action')
    age=time.monotonic()-proof['host_read_returned_monotonic_s']
    need(0<=age<=FRESH_READ_SECONDS,'bounded live-read return expired; no main input')
    return age


def same_value(a,b):
    return json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)==json.dumps(
        b,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)


def command_stream(path,maximum):
    """Command stdout/stderr may be empty; evidence JSON/model inputs may not."""
    path=Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute() and path.name.endswith(('.stdout.bin','.stderr.bin'))
         and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path,*path.parents)),
         'absolute non-symlink command stream required')
    need(type(maximum) is int and maximum>=0,'bounded command stream size required')
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        before=os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and 0<=before.st_size<=maximum,'invalid command stream size/type')
        raw=stream.read(maximum+1);after=os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    def key(value):return (value.st_dev,value.st_ino,value.st_size,value.st_mtime_ns,value.st_ctime_ns)
    need(len(raw)==before.st_size and key(before)==key(after)==key(path.stat()),'command stream changed while read')
    return raw


def original_command(h,args,label,words,maximum=512<<10):
    """Bind an existing command triplet without creating any transport."""
    paths=list((args.out/'commands').glob('*-'+label+'.json'))
    need(len(paths)==1,'one original command required: '+label)
    path=paths[0];raw=h.checked_file(path);meta=h.strict(raw)
    sequence=re.fullmatch(r'([0-9]{5})-'+re.escape(label)+r'\.json',path.name)
    need(sequence is not None,'canonical command sequence required: '+label)
    expected=[args.adb,'-H',args.adb_host,'-P',str(args.adb_port),'-s',args.serial,
        'shell','-T',shlex.join(words)]
    stdout=command_stream(path.with_suffix('.stdout.bin'),maximum)
    stderr=command_stream(path.with_suffix('.stderr.bin'),4096)
    need(meta.get('argv')==expected and type(meta.get('exit_code')) is int and meta['exit_code']==0
        and meta.get('client_timed_out') is False and type(meta.get('stdin_bytes')) is int
        and meta['stdin_bytes']==0 and meta.get('stdin_sha256') is None and not stderr,
        'actual command/exit/stdio differs: '+label)
    return stdout,{'path':str(path.relative_to(args.out)),'command_index':int(sequence[1]),'metadata_sha256':h.digest(raw),
        'stdout_sha256':h.digest(stdout),'stdout_bytes':len(stdout),'stderr_sha256':h.digest(stderr)}


def original_clock(h,args,label,recorded):
    """Reparse one actual command triplet, not its caller-supplied summary."""
    stdout,reference=original_command(h,args,label,
        ['cat','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/uptime'],4096)
    lines=stdout.decode('utf-8',errors='strict').strip().splitlines()
    need(len(lines)==2 and h.UUID.fullmatch(lines[0]),'raw clock boot/uptime shape differs')
    match=re.fullmatch(r'([0-9]+)\.([0-9]{2})\s+[0-9]+\.[0-9]{2}',lines[1])
    need(match is not None,'raw clock precision differs')
    lower=int(match[1])*1000+int(match[2])*10
    clock={'boot_id':lines[0],'elapsed_ms_lower':lower,'elapsed_ms_upper':lower+10,
        'source':'/proc/uptime first field; 10 ms quantization','raw_sha256':h.digest(stdout)}
    need(same_value(clock,recorded),'clock summary differs from actual raw command: '+label)
    return clock,reference


def original_settings_surface(h,args,tag,recorded):
    """Recompute the exact observed gesture rectangle and image bytes."""
    base=args.out/'main-user'
    png=h.checked_file(base/(tag+'.png'),16<<20)
    displays=h.checked_file(base/(tag+'-displays.txt'))
    windows=h.checked_file(base/(tag+'-windows.txt'))
    with h.png_rgba(png) as image:
        geometry=h.settings_content_geometry(displays.decode('utf-8'),windows.decode('utf-8'),image.size)
        with image.crop(geometry['content_rect']) as content:content_sha=h.digest(content.tobytes())
    computed={'png':tag+'.png','png_sha256':h.digest(png),'content_rgba_sha256':content_sha,
        'geometry':geometry,'window_displays_sha256':h.digest(displays),'window_records_sha256':h.digest(windows)}
    need(same_value(computed,recorded),'Settings surface/geometry differs from original raw bytes: '+tag)
    return computed


class ReadinessReader:
    """Only the existing five system reads, sharing a single time budget."""
    def __init__(self,adb,deadline):
        self.adb,self.deadline=adb,deadline

    def command(self,words,**kwargs):
        allowed=(['dumpsys','activity','activities'],['cmd','display','get-displays'],
            ['dumpsys','window','displays'],['dumpsys','input'],['ps','-A','-o','UID,PID,PPID,ARGS'])
        need(words in allowed,'only fixed read-only readiness commands allowed')
        remaining=self.deadline-time.monotonic()
        need(remaining>0,'Settings readiness observation deadline reached; no relaunch')
        kwargs['timeout']=min(kwargs.get('timeout',8),remaining)
        return self.adb.command(words,**kwargs)


def perform(h,live,adb,args,report,samples,task,candidate):
    record=report['main_user'];spec=candidate['spec'];context=candidate['context']
    record.update(protocol=PROTOCOL,trigger_candidate=candidate,continuous_npu_busy_verified=False,
                  actual_preceding_tool_effect_required_by_legacy_protocol=False,
                  legacy_v50_coexistence_protocol_unchanged=True)
    record['before_launch_surface']=h.main_surface(adb,args,'before-settings-launch')
    proof=live.capture(adb,h,spec,context,args.out,'launch-before')
    record['launch_before_fence']=proof
    record['launch_fence_age_s']=require_fresh(proof)
    record['launch_started_clock']=h.device_elapsed(adb,'main-user-launch-before-clock')
    require_fresh(proof)
    command=['am','start','-W','--display','0','-a','android.settings.SETTINGS','-p',SETTINGS]
    record['phase']='settings_launch';record['launch_attempted']=True
    record['host_actions'].append({'actor':'host_simulated_main_user','model_issued':False,'task_action':False,
        'kind':'normal_settings_launch','argv':command,'display_id':0})
    adb.command(command,label='main-user-settings-launch-on-display0',timeout=15)
    returned=time.monotonic();deadline=returned+SETTLE_SECONDS
    record['launch_host_returned_monotonic_s']=returned
    record['launch_returned_clock']=h.device_elapsed(adb,'main-user-launch-after-clock')
    record['launch_after_fence']=live.capture(adb,h,spec,context,args.out,'launch-after')
    # The 3-second window concerns read-only readiness after this one launch.
    # It does not extend the phone task or promise a hard total I/O duration.
    record['settings_readiness_samples']=[];reader=ReadinessReader(adb,deadline)
    while True:
        need(time.monotonic()<deadline,'Settings readiness observation deadline reached; no relaunch')
        row=h.system_snapshot(reader,args.out,len(samples),args.target_package,phase='settings_launch');samples.append(row)
        record['settings_readiness_samples'].append(row['index'])
        need(time.monotonic()<=deadline,'Settings readiness observation exceeded its window; no swipe')
        need(not row['errors'],'Settings readiness system sample could not be parsed')
        need(row.get('target_task_displays')==[context['display_id']],
             'owned Notes task ended/escaped while Settings was opening; no swipe')
        fc=row.get('main_focus_context') or {}
        need(transition(fc),'Settings transition lacks its own exact display-0 context; no retry')
        if ready(fc):
            record['settings_settled_sample_index']=row['index'];record['settings_settled_focus']=row['main_focus']
            record['settings_readiness_observed']=True
            record['settings_readiness_elapsed_s']=time.monotonic()-returned;break
        need(time.monotonic()<deadline,'Settings focus not ready within bounded read-only window; no relaunch')
        # The next actual input still requires a new full same-task live fence.
        # Avoid a second unbounded private-state read during this short window.
        time.sleep(min(0.15,max(0,deadline-time.monotonic())))
    record['phase']='settings'
    surface_started=time.monotonic();before=h.main_surface(adb,args,'settings-before-swipe',settings=True)
    record['before_swipe_surface']=before
    proof=live.capture(adb,h,spec,context,args.out,'swipe-before');record['swipe_before_fence']=proof
    record['swipe_fence_age_s']=require_fresh(proof)
    left,top,right,bottom=before['geometry']['content_rect']
    x,y0,y1=(left+right)//2,top+(bottom-top)//3,top+3*(bottom-top)//4
    command=['input','-d','0','swipe',str(x),str(y0),str(x),str(y1),'450']
    record['swipe_started_clock']=h.device_elapsed(adb,'main-user-swipe-before-clock')
    need(time.monotonic()-surface_started<=10,'fresh Settings window/screenshot expired; no swipe')
    require_fresh(proof)
    record['swipe_attempted']=True
    record['host_actions'].append({'actor':'host_simulated_main_user','model_issued':False,'task_action':False,
        'kind':'normal_list_swipe_request','argv':command,'display_id':0,'window_geometry':before['geometry'],
        'settings_item_clicked':False,'settings_value_modified_by_driver':False})
    adb.command(command,label='main-user-settings-content-swipe-display0',timeout=4)
    record['swipe_returned_clock']=h.device_elapsed(adb,'main-user-swipe-after-clock')
    # A task that ended during the swipe remains truthfully recorded as such.
    # No second swipe or synthetic task extension can make this fence eligible.
    record['swipe_after_fence']=live.capture(adb,h,spec,context,args.out,'swipe-after')
    record['post_swipe_absence_fences']=record['swipe_after_fence'].get('future_before_absence',[])
    after=h.main_surface(adb,args,'settings-after-swipe',settings=True);record['after_swipe_surface']=after
    record['application_pixels_changed']=(before['geometry']['content_rect']==after['geometry']['content_rect']
        and before['content_rgba_sha256']!=after['content_rgba_sha256'])
    record['main_scroll_visual_review_required']=True
    record['scroll_claim']='one ordinary host swipe; actual before/after image review and active-work proof are separate'
    samples.append(h.system_snapshot(adb,args.out,len(samples),args.target_package,phase='settings'))
    record['completed']=True
    h.write_new(args.out/'main-user'/'actions.json',record)


def phases(samples,record):
    """Keep the startup null/Splash sample visible as transition, never stable."""
    settled=record.get('settings_settled_sample_index');focus=record.get('settings_settled_focus')
    if type(settled) is not int:return False
    seen_launch=False;seen_settings=False
    for row in samples:
        if row.get('errors'):return False
        phase=row.get('main_user_phase')
        if phase=='hepta':
            if seen_launch or seen_settings or row.get('main_focus')!=samples[0].get('main_focus') or row.get('input_focused_display')!=0:return False
        elif phase=='settings_launch':
            if seen_settings or row['index']>settled or not transition(row.get('main_focus_context') or {}):return False
            seen_launch=True
            if row['index']==settled and (not ready(row.get('main_focus_context') or {}) or row['main_focus']!=focus):return False
        elif phase=='settings':
            if not seen_launch or row['index']<=settled or row.get('main_focus')!=focus or not ready(row.get('main_focus_context') or {}):return False
            seen_settings=True
        else:return False
    return seen_launch and seen_settings


def verdict(h,live,args,report,samples,actions,by_file,child_proof,*,
            expected_background_selection,preparation_original_sha256):
    record=report.get('main_user') or {};candidate=record.get('trigger_candidate') or {}
    spec=candidate.get('spec') or {};context=candidate.get('context') or {}
    fences=[];bound_fences={};fence_refs={};raw_binding=False;actual_input_refs=[];live_command_refs=[];missing=[]
    try:
        index=candidate['system_sample_index'];sample=next(row for row in samples if row['index']==index)
        expected=live.first_worker(sample,report['task_id'],args.expected_uid,report['model_profile'],
            context=spec['context_tokens'],threads=spec['threads'],app_pid=report['prestart_formal_service_binding']['app_pid'])
        need(expected==spec,'live worker spec differs from actual indexed system sample')
        # Both added context values come from independently rehashed preparation and OWNER recomputation.
        # The full nine-field context is compared; no extra field is discarded or self-attested.
        need(same_value(context,{'owner':report['instruction'],'config_sha256':report['runtime_config_sha256'],
            'display_id':candidate['display_id'],'background_generation':candidate['generation'],
            'model_sha256':report['expected_model_sha256'],'body':report['plan']['body'],
            'notes_identity':report['installed_identity_before']['notes'],
            'expected_background_selection':expected_background_selection,
            'preparation_original_sha256':preparation_original_sha256}),
            'live context differs from original runtime/task/preparation')
        path_map=dict((name,path) for name,mode,path in live.paths(spec))
        for tag,key in [('launch-before','launch_before_fence'),('launch-after','launch_after_fence'),
                        ('swipe-before','swipe_before_fence'),('swipe-after','swipe_after_fence')]:
            recorded=record[key];raw=h.checked_file(args.out/'main-user'/'live-work'/tag/'stream.bin',live.MAX_STREAM)
            need(h.digest(raw)==recorded['stream_sha256'],'actual live fence stream changed')
            command_raw,command_ref=original_command(h,args,'live-work-'+tag,['sh','-c',live.read_script(spec)],live.MAX_STREAM)
            need(command_raw==raw,'live stream differs from original read-only command stdout: '+tag)
            live_command_refs.append(command_ref);fence_refs[tag]=command_ref
            rows=live.parse_stream(raw,spec);proof=live.evaluate(rows,spec,context)
            need(proof.get('eligible') is True and recorded.get('eligible') is True,'main action boundary was not independently in flight: '+tag)
            need(all(key in recorded and same_value(value,recorded[key]) for key,value in proof.items()),
                 'recorded live proof differs from actual stream: '+tag)
            fences.append(proof);bound_fences[tag]=proof
            for name in ('owner','bootstrap','model_before','prompt','system','grammar','input_meta','input_ids'):
                relative=path_map[name]
                if relative.startswith('files/runs/'):
                    final=args.out/'evidence'/'runs'/Path(relative).parts[-2]/Path(relative).name
                else:final=args.out/'evidence'/'task'/Path(relative).name
                actual=h.checked_file(final,16<<20)
                need(rows[name]['mode']=='F' and rows[name]['raw']==actual,'live input differs from terminal raw bytes: '+name)
                actual_input_refs.append({'fence':tag,'name':name,'sha256':h.digest(actual),'bytes':len(actual)})
            if proof['phase']=='native_request_entered_generate':
                log=h.checked_file(args.out/'evidence'/'runs'/spec['worker_generation']/'stderr.log',8<<20)
                start=rows['sdk_log']['offset'];size=rows['sdk_log']['bytes']
                need(log[start:start+size]==rows['sdk_log']['raw'],'SDK live log segment differs from final same-worker log')
        associated={row.get('run_id') for row in report.get('collection',{}).get('associated_runs',[])}
        need(spec['run_id'] in associated and report.get('input_ids_evidence',{}).get('all_associated_ids_bytes_verified') is True,
             'live first request not in actual final native/IDs collection')
        matching=[row for row in actions if row.get('run_id')==spec['run_id']]
        need(len(matching)==1 and matching[0].get('model_binding_valid') is True,'first request final native-model binding failed')
        if any(p['phase']=='tool_workflow_inflight' for p in fences):
            need(child_proof.get('verified') is True and child_proof.get('parent',{}).get('parent_run_id')==spec['run_id'],
                 'observed workflow lacks independent completed child chain')
        raw_binding=True
    except (RuntimeError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,StopIteration,OSError) as error:missing.append(str(error))
    clocks=[];clock_refs=[];clock_map={};clock_ok=False;absence_bound=False;absences=[]
    try:
        need(len(bound_fences)==4 and raw_binding,'four independently bound live fences required')
        for tag,start_key,end_key in [('launch','launch_started_clock','launch_returned_clock'),
                                     ('swipe','swipe_started_clock','swipe_returned_clock')]:
            before=bound_fences[tag+'-before'];after=bound_fences[tag+'-after']
            start,start_ref=original_clock(h,args,'main-user-'+tag+'-before-clock',record.get(start_key))
            end,end_ref=original_clock(h,args,'main-user-'+tag+'-after-clock',record.get(end_key))
            clock_map[tag+'-before']=start_ref;clock_map[tag+'-after']=end_ref
            clock_refs.extend([start_ref,end_ref])
            clocks.extend([fence_clock(before,'before'),fence_clock(before,'after'),start,end,
                           fence_clock(after,'before'),fence_clock(after,'after')])
        clock_ok=(all(type(x.get('elapsed_ms_lower')) is int and type(x.get('elapsed_ms_upper')) is int
                      and x['elapsed_ms_upper']==x['elapsed_ms_lower']+10
                      and h.UUID.fullmatch(str(x.get('boot_id',''))) for x in clocks)
            and len({x['boot_id'] for x in clocks})==1
            and all(a['elapsed_ms_lower']<=b['elapsed_ms_lower'] for a,b in zip(clocks,clocks[1:])))
        need(clock_ok,'actual same-boot clock order differs')
        absences=bound_fences['swipe-after']['future_before_absence']
        need(same_value(absences,record.get('post_swipe_absence_fences')),
             'later-effect absence summary differs from actual post-swipe stream')
        absence_bound=True
    except (RuntimeError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,OSError,UnicodeError) as error:missing.append(str(error))

"""Bounded Moto Notes observed-text matching; raw bytes are never normalized.

The observed 40-LF form does not establish whether those LFs are stored content,
renderer behavior, or accessibility behavior. Save/list/reopen remain separate.
"""
import hashlib
import re

NOTES = "com.motorola.stylus"
RULE = "exact_body_or_same_body_plus_exactly_40_lf_on_observed_moto_apk.v1"
OBSERVED_NOTES_APK_SHA256 = "0e1a52a937c04ec8df380bff3750ce4b345fa0d8d33683e5ae8aa08e70e94017"
PERSISTENCE_LIMIT = "Unknown whether trailing LF characters are stored content, rendering behavior or accessibility behavior; no DOM/database proof is supplied."


def digest(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def observed_notes_identity(installed):
    return (isinstance(installed, dict) and installed.get("package") == NOTES
            and type(installed.get("uid")) is int and 10000 <= installed["uid"] < 90000)


def observed_notes_apk(installed):
    rows = installed.get("apks") if isinstance(installed, dict) else None
    return (observed_notes_identity(installed) and isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == 1
            and isinstance(rows[0], dict) and rows[0].get("sha256") == OBSERVED_NOTES_APK_SHA256)


def text_form(text, body, installed):
    proof = {"rule": RULE, "matched": False, "raw_exact": False,
             "form": "mismatch", "persistent_lf_semantics_verified": False,
             "persistence_limit": PERSISTENCE_LIMIT, "observed_notes_apk_match": observed_notes_apk(installed)}
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not isinstance(body, str) or not body:
        proof["reason"] = "actual text and nonempty expected body required"
        return proof
    try:
        raw, expected = text.encode("utf-8", "strict"), body.encode("utf-8", "strict")
    except UnicodeError:
        proof["reason"] = "invalid Unicode text"
        return proof
    trailing = 0
    for character in reversed(text):
        if character != "\n":
            break
        trailing += 1
    exact = text == body
    forty = text == body + "\n" * 40
    matched = observed_notes_identity(installed) and (exact or forty and observed_notes_apk(installed))
    proof.update(matched=bool(matched), raw_exact=exact,
                 form="raw_exact" if exact else "body_plus_observed_40_lf" if forty else "mismatch",
                 raw_text_sha256=digest(raw), expected_body_sha256=digest(expected),
                 raw_utf8_bytes=len(raw), expected_utf8_bytes=len(expected),
                 raw_code_points=len(text), expected_code_points=len(body), trailing_lf_count=trailing,
                 raw_equals_expected_plus_40_lf=forty,
                 difference="none" if exact else "exactly 40 LF after original body" if forty else "unsupported raw difference")
    return proof


def ordinary_window(observation):
    window = observation.get("window") if isinstance(observation, dict) else None
    return (isinstance(window, dict) and window.get("metadata_status") == "observed"
            and type(window.get("display_id")) is int and window["display_id"] == 0
            and type(window.get("type")) is int and window["type"] == 1
            and type(observation.get("window_id")) is int and observation["window_id"] >= 0
            and type(window.get("window_id")) is int and window["window_id"] == observation["window_id"]
            and observation.get("background_session") is None)


def editor_body(observation, body, installed):
    nodes = observation.get("nodes", []) if isinstance(observation, dict) else []
    valid_nodes = isinstance(nodes, list) and len(nodes) <= 200 and all(isinstance(n, dict) for n in nodes)
    context = (valid_nodes and observation.get("package") == NOTES and ordinary_window(observation)
               and observation.get("nodes_truncated") is False and any(n.get("text") == "NoteEditor" for n in nodes))
    rows = []
    if valid_nodes:
        for node in nodes:
            if node.get("editable") is not True:
                continue
            form = text_form(node.get("text"), body, installed)
            full_hash = (isinstance(node.get("input_text_sha256"), str)
                         and node["input_text_sha256"] == form.get("raw_text_sha256"))
            node_identity = isinstance(node.get("id"), str) and re.fullmatch(r"n[0-9]{1,5}", node["id"]) is not None
            rows.append({"node_id": node.get("id"), "view_id": node.get("view_id"), "bounds": node.get("bounds"),
                         "editable": True, "focused": node.get("focused"), "complete_input_hash_matches_raw": full_hash,
                         "body_form": form, "matched": bool(form["matched"] and full_hash and node_identity)})
    matched = [row for row in rows if row["matched"]]
    return {"source": "same_native_observation_editable_node_and_NoteEditor_context", "rule": RULE,
            "matched": bool(context and len(matched) == 1), "editor_context_verified": bool(context),
            "raw_exact": bool(context and len(matched) == 1 and matched[0]["body_form"]["raw_exact"]),
            "editable_fields": rows, "matching_fields_count": len(matched),
            "persistence_limit": PERSISTENCE_LIMIT}


LIST_RULE = "unique_complete_body_executable_all_notes_item.v2"
CHILD_SOURCE = "visible_noninteractive_descendants.v2"
LIST_TEXT_SCOPE = "Complete accessibility text source; visual clipping and persistent storage bytes are unverified."


def _unicode(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return False
    try:
        value.encode("utf-8", "strict")
        return True
    except UnicodeError:
        return False


def _utf16_length(value):
    return len(value.encode("utf-16-be", "strict")) // 2


def _java_field(value):
    return str(_utf16_length(value)) + ":" + value


def _java_trim(value):
    # java.lang.String.trim(), not Python's broader Unicode strip().
    first, last = 0, len(value)
    while first < last and ord(value[first]) <= 0x20:
        first += 1
    while last > first and ord(value[last - 1]) <= 0x20:
        last -= 1
    return value[first:last]


def _full_label(node):
    text, description = node.get("text", ""), node.get("description", "")
    if _java_trim(text):
        return text
    if _java_trim(description):
        return description
    if node.get("child_text_status") != "derived" or node.get("child_text_truncated") is not False:
        return ""
    return node.get("child_text", "")


def _project_label(value):
    if _utf16_length(value) <= 36:
        return value
    units, prefix = 0, []
    for char in value:
        width = 2 if ord(char) > 0xffff else 1
        if units + width > 36:
            break
        units += width
        prefix.append(char)
    return "".join(prefix) + "…"


def _sha(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value) is not None


def _valid_bounds(node):
    b = node.get("bounds")
    return (isinstance(b, list) and len(b) == 4 and all(type(x) is int for x in b)
            and 0 <= b[0] < b[2] and 0 <= b[1] < b[3])


def _inside(node, outer):
    b, o = node["bounds"], outer["bounds"]
    return o[0] <= b[0] < b[2] <= o[2] and o[1] <= b[1] < b[3] <= o[3]


def _summary_source(node, body, label):
    """Recompute the frozen ObservedChildText fingerprint, then its parent bind.

    Bounds only establish list scope. They never invent a descendant relation.
    The exact serialized source path/view ID/hash supplies that relationship.
    """
    child, sources = node.get("child_text"), node.get("child_text_sources")
    root, bound = node.get("child_text_root_signature"), node.get("node_app_tree_sha256")
    visited = node.get("child_text_visited")
    if not (node.get("view_id") == NOTES + ":id/note_item_content" and node.get("text", "") == ""
            and node.get("child_text_status") == "derived" and node.get("child_text_truncated") is False
            and node.get("child_text_sources_complete") is True and node.get("child_text_source") == CHILD_SOURCE
            and _unicode(child) and child == label and 0 < _utf16_length(child) <= 96
            and type(visited) is int and 1 <= visited <= 16 and isinstance(sources, list) and 1 <= len(sources) <= 3
            and _sha(root) and _sha(bound)):
        return None
    fields = [CHILD_SOURCE, "derived", child, "false", root, "true"]
    paths, summaries = set(), []
    for source in sources:
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or set(source) != {"descendant_path", "property", "text_sha256", "node_signature", "view_id"}:
            return None
        path = source["descendant_path"]
        if not (isinstance(path, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{1,2}(?:/[0-9]{1,2}){0,3}", path)
                and all(str(int(part)) == part and int(part) < 16 for part in path.split("/"))
                and path not in paths and source["property"] in ("text", "description")
                and _sha(source["text_sha256"]) and _sha(source["node_signature"]) and _unicode(source["view_id"])):
            return None
        paths.add(path)
        fields.extend(source[k] for k in ("descendant_path", "property", "text_sha256", "node_signature", "view_id"))
        if source["view_id"] == NOTES + ":id/note_summary":
            summaries.append(source)
    fingerprint = digest("".join(_java_field(value) for value in fields).encode("utf-8"))
    if digest((_java_field(root) + _java_field(fingerprint)).encode("utf-8")) != bound:
        return None
    if len(summaries) != 1 or summaries[0]["property"] != "text" or summaries[0]["text_sha256"] != digest(body.encode("utf-8")):
        return None
    return {**summaries[0], "child_fingerprint_sha256": fingerprint, "child_root_signature": root,
            "node_app_tree_sha256": bound}


def note_list(observation, body):
    """Same full-body list predicate as NotesCompletionEvidence.list, from raw JSON.

    PhoneObservation omits per-node package and true enabled values; the fixed
    source's scoped observation supplies the package and these exact defaults.
    Collected file/native identity is checked separately by the caller.
    """
    proof = {"rule": LIST_RULE, "matched": False, "list_context_verified": False, "item": None,
             "matching_item_count": 0, "text_scope": LIST_TEXT_SCOPE, "persistent_bytes_verified": False}
    def need(ok, reason):
        if not ok:
            raise ValueError(reason)
    try:
        need(isinstance(observation, dict) and observation.get("package") == NOTES and ordinary_window(observation), "actual_ordinary_notes_window_required")
        need(isinstance(observation.get("observation_id"), str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", observation["observation_id"]), "actual_observation_identity_required")
        nodes = observation.get("nodes")
        need(observation.get("nodes_truncated") is False and isinstance(nodes, list) and len(nodes) <= 200
             and all(isinstance(n, dict) for n in nodes), "complete_bounded_observed_nodes_required")
        need(_unicode(body) and bool(body) and "\0" not in body and _utf16_length(body) < 95 and not body.endswith("…"), "complete_unshortened_owner_body_required")
        ids = set()
        for node in nodes:
            identity = node.get("id")
            need(isinstance(identity, str) and re.fullmatch(r"n[0-9]{1,5}", identity) and identity not in ids, "unique_actual_node_ids_required")
            ids.add(identity)
            need(all(_unicode(node.get(k, "")) for k in ("text", "description", "view_id", "child_text")), "valid_raw_node_strings_required")
            need(node.get("package", NOTES) == NOTES and all(k not in node or type(node[k]) is bool for k in
                 ("clickable", "editable", "scrollable", "enabled", "password", "child_text_truncated", "child_text_sources_complete")), "scoped_raw_node_flags_required")
        need(not any(n.get("editable") is True or n.get("text") == "NoteEditor" for n in nodes), "editor_present_not_note_list")
        need(not any(n.get("view_id") == NOTES + ":id/no_note_text" and n.get("text", "") for n in nodes), "empty_list_notice_present")
        eligible = lambda n: n.get("enabled", True) is True and n.get("password", False) is False and _valid_bounds(n)
        titles = [n for n in nodes if n.get("view_id") == NOTES + ":id/title_text" and n.get("text") == "所有笔记" and eligible(n)]
        pagers = [n for n in nodes if n.get("view_id") == NOTES + ":id/view_pager2" and n.get("scrollable") is True and eligible(n)]
        need(len(titles) == len(pagers) == 1, "unique_all_notes_title_and_scrollable_pager_required")
        proof.update(list_context_verified=True, observation_id=observation["observation_id"], window_id=observation["window_id"],
                     title_node_id=titles[0]["id"], pager_node_id=pagers[0]["id"], body_sha256=digest(body.encode("utf-8")))
        items = []
        for node in nodes:
            if node in (titles[0], pagers[0]) or node.get("clickable") is not True or not eligible(node) or not _inside(node, pagers[0]):
                continue
            if node.get("view_id") == NOTES + ":id/clickable_layout":
                continue
            label, text = _full_label(node), node.get("text", "")
            own = body == text == label
            full = text == "" and body == label and node.get("child_text_status") != "derived"
            source = _summary_source(node, body, label)
            if own or full or source is not None:
                items.append({"node_id": node["id"], "node_label": _project_label(label), "full_label": label,
                              "bounds": node["bounds"], "view_id": node.get("view_id"),
                              "match_rule": "bound_note_summary_accessibility_text" if source else "exact_own_text" if own else "exact_nonderived_label",
                              "source": source, "node_app_tree_sha256": node.get("node_app_tree_sha256")})
        proof["matching_item_count"] = len(items)
        need(len(items) == 1, "complete_body_on_one_executable_list_item_missing" if not items else "complete_body_list_item_is_not_unique")
        proof.update(matched=True, item=items[0], missing=None)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, UnicodeError) as error:
        proof["missing"] = str(error)
    return proof


def current_body(ui, body, installed, pa):
    foreground = pa.ui_predicates(ui, NOTES, [], contains=False)
    rows = []
    def visit(node, in_editor=False):
        own = node.get("package") == NOTES
        context = in_editor or (own and node.get("class") == "android.webkit.WebView" and node.get("text") == "NoteEditor")
        if (own and context and node.get("class") == "android.widget.EditText" and node.get("enabled") == "true"
                and node.get("password") != "true" and node.get("visible-to-user", "true") != "false"):
            form = text_form(node.get("text"), body, installed)
            rows.append({"class": node.get("class"), "resource_id": node.get("resource-id"), "bounds": node.get("bounds"),
                         "focused": node.get("focused"), "inside_observed_NoteEditor": True, "body_form": form})
        for child in node:
            visit(child, context and (own or node.tag == "hierarchy"))
    visit(ui["xml"])
    matched = [row for row in rows if row["body_form"]["matched"]]
    return {"all_passed": bool(foreground["all_passed"] and len(matched) == 1), "foreground": foreground,
            "source": "independent_current_XML_EditText_inside_Moto_NoteEditor", "rule": RULE,
            "raw_exact": bool(foreground["all_passed"] and len(matched) == 1 and matched[0]["body_form"]["raw_exact"]),
            "editor_fields": rows, "matching_fields_count": len(matched), "persistence_limit": PERSISTENCE_LIMIT}


# The verifier below is the frozen r3 intent proof with only its editor-body
# postcondition replaced. The explicit base aliases reuse the original v6 code.
# Actual payload, native input/output, observation bytes and hashes stay intact.
def verify_note_intent(base, pa, directory, path, receipt, before, after, plan, binding, collection, installed_notes):
    require, payload_valid = base.require, base.payload_valid
    collected_json, collected_bytes = base.collected_json, base.collected_bytes
    target_identity = base.target_identity
    SCHEMA, RESULT_KEYS, JOURNAL_KEYS = base.SCHEMA, base.RESULT_KEYS, base.JOURNAL_KEYS
    IDENTITY, PROFILES = base.IDENTITY, base.PROFILES
    proof = {"verified": False, "new_note_creation_review_required": True, "launch_is_not_save_proof": True}
    try:
        require(binding.get("verified") is True and binding.get("task_session_binding_valid") is True
                and isinstance(installed_notes, dict) and installed_notes.get("package") == NOTES
                and type(installed_notes.get("uid")) is int and 10000 <= installed_notes["uid"] < 90000,
                "complete native task binding and actual installed Notes identity required")
        action = receipt.get("action")
        require(isinstance(action, dict) and action.get("action") == "notes.create" and action.get("package") == NOTES
                and action.get("text") == plan["body"] and payload_valid(action["text"]), "exact owner note payload required")
        require(receipt.get("accepted") is True and receipt.get("dispatched") is True and receipt.get("stale") is False
                and receipt.get("model_issued") is True and receipt.get("background_session") is None, "accepted ordinary model dispatch required")
        require(collected_json(pa, directory, str(path.relative_to(directory)), collection) == receipt, "action collection differs")
        run = receipt.get("model_run_id")
        require(isinstance(run, str) and pa.HEX32.fullmatch(run), "exact model run required")
        runs = [r for r in collection.get("associated_runs", []) if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("run_id") == run]
        require(len(runs) == 1 and isinstance(runs[0].get("files"), list), "unique collected native run required")
        native_files = {name: collected_bytes(pa, directory, "runs/" + run + "/" + name, runs[0]["files"])
                        for name in ("app-receipt.json", "native-result.json", "prompt.txt", "grammar.gbnf", "raw-text.txt")}
        app, native = [pa.strict_json(native_files[n]) for n in ("app-receipt.json", "native-result.json")]
        require(app.get("grammar_schema") == SCHEMA and app.get("run_id") == run and native.get("request_id") == run
                and pa.strict_json(native_files["raw-text.txt"]) == action
                and pa.controller_grammar_binding_valid(app, native, native_files["grammar.gbnf"],
                    {before.get("observation_id"): {before.get("package")}}, native_files["prompt.txt"], native_files["raw-text.txt"]),
                "exact v6 native prompt/grammar/decision binding required")
        prefix = path.name[:-len("-action.json")]
        for suffix, observation in (("before", before), ("after", after)):
            require(collected_json(pa, directory, "task/" + prefix + "-" + suffix + ".json", collection) == observation, "observation collection differs")
            window = observation.get("window")
            require(isinstance(window, dict) and window.get("metadata_status") == "observed"
                    and type(window.get("display_id")) is int and window["display_id"] == 0
                    and type(window.get("type")) is int and window["type"] == 1
                    and type(observation.get("window_id")) is int and observation["window_id"] >= 0
                    and type(window.get("window_id")) is int and window["window_id"] == observation["window_id"]
                    and observation.get("background_session") is None, "ordinary observed application window required")
        body_observation = editor_body(after, plan["body"], installed_notes)
        proof["body_observation"] = body_observation
        require(body_observation["matched"], "actual editor body does not match an explicitly supported observed form")
        result = receipt.get("fixed_intent")
        require(isinstance(result, dict) and set(result) == RESULT_KEYS
                and result.get("schema") == "hepta.fixed-intent-result.v1"
                and all(result.get(k) is True for k in ("attempt_consumed", "dispatch_attempted", "api_accepted"))
                and all(result.get(k) is False for k in ("automatic_retry_allowed", "goal_independently_verified", "saved_or_search_results_verified"))
                and result.get("result") == "launch_accepted" and result.get("requested_outcome") == "draft_opened"
                and type(result.get("attempt_ordinal")) is int and 1 <= result["attempt_ordinal"] <= 2,
                "fixed result is not an accepted one-time draft request")
        owner = collected_json(pa, directory, "task/owner.json", collection)
        expected = {"task_id": collection.get("task_id"), "model_run_id": receipt.get("model_run_id"),
                    "observation_id": before.get("observation_id"), "source_package": before.get("package"),
                    "source_window_id": before["window_id"], "display_id": 0, "background_generation": None,
                    "action": "notes.create", "payload_sha256": pa.digest(plan["body"].encode("utf-8"))}
        require(owner.get("task_id") == expected["task_id"] and owner.get("background_request") is None
                and action.get("observation_id") == expected["observation_id"]
                and all(result.get(k) == v and type(result.get(k)) is type(v) for k, v in expected.items()), "fixed result identity differs from task/native/current frame")
        require(target_identity(result["target"], "notes.create") == action.get("app_label")
                and result["target"]["target_uid"] == installed_notes.get("uid"), "installed Notes UID or projected label differs")
        journals = sorted((directory / "task").glob("fixed-intent-*-attempt.json"))
        require(1 <= len(journals) <= 2, "bounded durable fixed-intent journal required")
        seen_actions, seen_ids, seen_ordinals, matching = set(), set(), set(), []
        for journal_path in journals:
            journal = collected_json(pa, directory, str(journal_path.relative_to(directory)), collection)
            require(isinstance(journal, dict) and set(journal) == JOURNAL_KEYS
                    and journal.get("schema") == "hepta.fixed-intent-attempt.v1" and journal.get("stage") == "consumed_before_call"
                    and journal.get("attempt_consumed") is True and journal.get("automatic_retry_allowed") is False
                    and journal.get("task_id") == expected["task_id"] and journal.get("action") in PROFILES,
                    "journal fields/consumption differ")
            ordinal, operation = journal.get("attempt_ordinal"), journal["action"]
            require(type(ordinal) is int and 1 <= ordinal <= 2 and journal_path.name == "fixed-intent-%02d-attempt.json" % ordinal, "journal filename/ordinal differs")
            for key in ("task_id", "model_run_id", "observation_id"):
                require(isinstance(journal.get(key), str) and pa.HEX32.fullmatch(journal[key]), "journal identity malformed")
            require(isinstance(journal.get("source_package"), str) and bool(journal["source_package"])
                    and type(journal.get("source_window_id")) is int and journal["source_window_id"] >= 0
                    and type(journal.get("display_id")) is int and journal["display_id"] == 0
                    and journal.get("background_generation") is None, "journal is not bound to an ordinary foreground window")
            require(isinstance(journal.get("payload_sha256"), str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", journal["payload_sha256"]), "journal payload SHA malformed")
            target_identity(journal["target"], operation)
            computed = pa.digest((journal["task_id"] + "|" + str(ordinal) + "|" + operation + "|" + journal["payload_sha256"]).encode())
            require(journal.get("attempt_id") == computed and operation not in seen_actions and computed not in seen_ids
                    and ordinal not in seen_ordinals, "duplicate or unbound consumed attempt")
            seen_actions.add(operation); seen_ids.add(computed); seen_ordinals.add(ordinal)
            if computed == result.get("attempt_id"):
                matching.append({k: journal[k] for k in IDENTITY})
        require(seen_ordinals == set(range(1, len(journals) + 1)) and len(matching) == 1
                and matching[0] == {k: result[k] for k in IDENTITY}, "result lacks exact pre-call durable identity")
        terminal = collected_json(pa, directory, "task/result.json", collection)
        attempts = terminal.get("fixed_intent_attempts")
        require(terminal.get("task_id") == expected["task_id"] and isinstance(attempts, list) and len(attempts) == len(journals)
                and all(isinstance(a, dict) for a in attempts)
                and {a.get("attempt_id") for a in attempts} == seen_ids
                and sum(a == result for a in attempts) == 1, "terminal does not retain the same consumed intent result")
        notes_effects = []
        for effect_path in sorted((directory / "task").glob("step-*-action.json")):
            effect = collected_json(pa, directory, str(effect_path.relative_to(directory)), collection)
            if (effect.get("action") or {}).get("action") == "notes.create" and effect.get("dispatched") is True:
                notes_effects.append(effect_path)
        require(notes_effects == [path], "notes.create has multiple possible dispatches")
        proof.update(verified=True, attempt_id=result["attempt_id"], attempt_ordinal=result["attempt_ordinal"],
                     payload_sha256=result["payload_sha256"], target_uid=result["target"]["target_uid"],
                     durable_attempt_file="task/fixed-intent-%02d-attempt.json" % result["attempt_ordinal"],
                     actual_editor_body_observed=True, saved_or_reopened_by_this_proof=False)
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError, UnicodeError, pa.DriverError) as error:
        proof["reason"] = str(error)
    return proof

def need(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def strict(raw):
    def pairs(rows):
        value = {}
        for key, item in rows:
            need(key not in value, 'duplicate JSON key')
            value[key] = item
        return value
    def bad(value):
        raise ValueError('nonfinite JSON: ' + value)
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=bad)


def identity(s):
    return (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_nlink, s.st_size, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)


def exact(path, maximum=32 << 20, allow_empty=False):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts
         and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), 'absolute nonsymlink source required')
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1
             and (0 if allow_empty else 1) <= before.st_size <= maximum, 'source size/type differs')
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    need(len(raw) == before.st_size and identity(before) == identity(after) == identity(path.stat()),
         'source changed during read')
    return raw, identity(before)


def write_new(path, raw):
    need(all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), 'output symlink refused')
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    need(exact(path, allow_empty=True)[0] == raw, 'created artifact readback differs')


def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def reference(path, raw):
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)}


def relative(name):
    need(isinstance(name, str) and name and not PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute()
         and '..' not in PurePosixPath(name).parts and str(PurePosixPath(name)) == name,
         'exact relative artifact name required')
    return name


def bounds(node):
    match = re.fullmatch(r'\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]\[([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\]', node.get('bounds', ''))
    need(match is not None, 'actual XML bounds unavailable')
    value = list(map(int, match.groups()))
    need(value[0] < value[2] and value[1] < value[3], 'positive XML bounds required')
    return value


def plan_rules():
    path = Path(__file__).absolute().with_name('background_notes_plan.py')
    raw, original = exact(path, 65536)
    need(sha(raw) == PLAN_RULES_SHA, 'actual dual UI/OWNER rules source differs')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('export_exact_notes_owner_rules', path)
    value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    exec(compile(raw, str(path), 'exec'), value.__dict__)
    need(exact(path, 65536) == (raw, original), 'dual UI rules source changed while loaded')
    return value

def make_preview(source, out, item, take):
    raw = take(item['relative_png'])
    need(sha(raw) == item['sha256'] and len(raw) == item['bytes'], 'selected original image differs')
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as image:
        image.load()
        need(image.format == 'PNG' and 0 < image.width <= 8192 and 0 < image.height <= 8192, 'bounded PNG required')
        dimensions = list(image.size)
        rgba_sha = sha(image.convert('RGBA').tobytes())
        preview = None
        attempts = []
        for bound_width in (480, 400):
            width = min(bound_width, image.width)
            frame = image.convert('RGB').resize((width, round(image.height * width / image.width)), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
            for quality in (60, 50, 40, 30, 20):
                memory = io.BytesIO()
                frame.save(memory, format='WEBP', quality=quality, method=4)
                candidate = memory.getvalue()
                attempts.append({'width': width, 'height': frame.height, 'quality': quality, 'bytes': len(candidate)})
                if len(candidate) <= 45000:
                    preview = candidate
                    break
            if preview is not None:
                break
        need(preview is not None, 'derived preview exceeds one bounded text-read payload after fixed fallback sequence')
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(preview)) as decoded:
            decoded.load()
            need(decoded.format == 'WEBP' and decoded.size == frame.size, 'derived preview decode differs')
        preview_dimensions = list(frame.size)
    name = item['role'] + '-preview.webp'
    write_new(out / name, preview)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(preview).decode('ascii')
    need(len(b64) < 65536 and base64.b64decode(b64, validate=True) == preview, 'preview base64 differs')
    payload = {'role': item['role'], 'bytes': len(preview), 'sha256': sha(preview),
               'base64_lines': [b64[i:i+256] for i in range(0, len(b64), 256)]}
    b64name = item['role'] + '-PREVIEW-BASE64.json'
    need(len(encoded(payload)) <= 65536, 'preview JSON exceeds bounded text payload')
    write_new(out / b64name, encoded(payload))
    info = {**item, 'original_png': {**reference(source/item['relative_png'], raw),
                'dimensions': dimensions, 'rgba8_sha256': rgba_sha},
        'preview': {**reference(out/name, preview), 'dimensions': preview_dimensions,
            'quality': quality, 'encoding': 'WebP', 'resample': 'LANCZOS', 'attempts': attempts,

            'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw), 'base64_lines': [full[i:i+256] for i in range(0, len(full), 256)]}))
        info['original_png']['base64_file'] = str(out/filename)
    return info, payload


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('source-root', 'out', 'plan'):
        parser.add_argument('--'+name, type=Path, required=True)
    for name in ('expected-result-sha256', 'expected-config-sha256', 'expected-plan-sha256', 'helper-sha256'):
        parser.add_argument('--'+name, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=tuple(HELPERS), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--helper-exit-code', type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source, out = args.source_root, args.out
    need(source.parent == out.parent == BASE and re.fullmatch(r'background-notes-v56-[a-z0-9-]+', source.name)
         and out.name == source.name+'-host-review-r1' and not out.exists()
         and not source.is_symlink() and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (*source.parents, *out.parents)),
         'exact existing v56 case and new sibling export required')
    for value in (args.expected_result_sha256, args.expected_config_sha256, args.expected_plan_sha256, args.helper_sha256):
        need(isinstance(value, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(value), 'actual complete digest required')
    need(args.helper_sha256 == HELPERS[args.kind][1] and 0 <= args.helper_exit_code <= 255,
         'actual frozen helper and original exit required')
    helper = BASE/'background-notes-adapters-v56-r1'/HELPERS[args.kind][0]
    helper_before = exact(helper)
    need(sha(helper_before[0]) == args.helper_sha256, 'executed helper source differs')
    need(isinstance(BUILD, Path) and BUILD.is_absolute()
         and isinstance(APK, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(APK)
         and isinstance(BUILD_SHA, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(BUILD_SHA)
         and isinstance(COMMIT, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', COMMIT),

    build_raw, _ = exact(BUILD)

    build = strict(build_raw)
    need(build.get('all_pass') is True and build.get('apk_sha256') == APK and build.get('source_commit') == COMMIT,
         'actual v56 build identity differs')
    plan_raw, plan_identity = exact(args.plan, 16384)
    need(sha(plan_raw) == args.expected_plan_sha256, 'actual immutable plan differs')
    plan = strict(plan_raw)
    originals = {}
    def take(name):
        path = source / relative(name)
        value = exact(path)
        if path in originals:
            need(originals[path] == value, 'source changed between reads')
        originals[path] = value

    result_raw = take('RESULT.json')

    expected_schema = {'prepare': 'hepta.ordinary-background-notes-ui-preparation.v1',

    expected_fields = {'plan_sha256': args.expected_plan_sha256, 'plan': plan,
        'instruction': plan['instruction'], 'instruction_sha256': plan['instruction_sha256'],
        'runtime_config_sha256': args.expected_config_sha256}
    missing_fields = []
    for field, expected in expected_fields.items():
        if field not in result:

    need(not missing_fields or (args.helper_exit_code != 0 and not any(result.get(field) is True
        for field in ('prepared', 'qualified', 'machine_checks_passed', 'cancel_machine_checks_passed'))),
        'successful original case cannot omit identity fields')
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)

    need(sha(packer_before[0]) == PACKER_SHA, 'original host-only terminal packer differs')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('pinned_host_evidence_packer', packer_path)
    packer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    exec(compile(packer_before[0], str(packer_path), 'exec'), packer.__dict__)
    packed = packer.pack(SimpleNamespace(source_root=str(source), expected_result_sha256=sha(result_raw),
        output=str(out/'original-records.tar.xz'), manifest=str(out/'ORIGINAL-MANIFEST.json')))
    write_new(out/'RESULT.json.xz', lzma.compress(result_raw, preset=6))
    errors = []

    try:

        else:

                               else 'hepta.background-notes-acceptance.v1')
            need(result.get('schema') == expected_schema, 'actual run RESULT schema differs')
            details, selected = task_visuals(source, result, take)
    except Exception as error:
        errors.append({'stage': 'visual_selection', 'error': type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)})
    visuals, payloads = [], []
    for item in selected:
        try:
            info, payload = make_preview(source, out, item, take)

            payloads.append(payload)
        except Exception as error:
            errors.append({'stage': 'preview', 'role': item['role'], 'error': type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)})
    write_new(out/'PREVIEW-BASE64.json', encoded({'schema': 'hepta.actual-case-derived-previews.v1',
        'lossy': True, 'pixel_equality_claimed': False, 'images': payloads,
        'individual_bounded_base64_files': [x['preview']['base64_file'] for x in visuals]}))
    reported = {k: result.get(k) for k in ('prepared', 'task_id', 'model_profile', 'compute', 'qualified',
        'machine_checks_passed', 'cancel_machine_checks_passed', 'error', 'started_wall_s', 'ended_wall_s')}
    reported['last_session'] = {k: (result.get('last_session') or {}).get(k)
        for k in ('task_id', 'status', 'steps', 'cleanup_known', 'running', 'blocked', 'background_lease_unreleased')}
    summary = {'schema': 'hepta.v56-one-helper-host-export-summary.v1', 'exporter_revision': 'r2-typed-frames-main-subdirectory-bounded-previews', 'export_has_phone_actions': False,
        'original_helper_exit_code': args.helper_exit_code, 'helper_sha256': args.helper_sha256,
        'source_result': reference(source/'RESULT.json', result_raw), 'actual_signed_build_receipt_sha256': BUILD_SHA,
        'apk_sha256': APK, 'runtime_config_sha256': args.expected_config_sha256,
        'plan': reference(args.plan, plan_raw), 'case_identity_fields_missing_in_failed_original': missing_fields,
        'reported_original_fields_not_independent_qualification': reported,
        'visual_selection': details, 'visuals': visuals, 'archive': packed,
        'export_errors': errors, 'business_qualification_assigned': False,
        'root_visual_review_pending': True, 'original_full_PNG_remains_runner_guard_input': True}
    for path, original in originals.items():
        need(exact(path) == original, 'original selected evidence changed during export')
    need(exact(helper) == helper_before and exact(packer_path, 1 << 20) == packer_before
         and exact(args.plan, 16384) == (plan_raw, plan_identity), 'helper/packer/plan changed during export')
    write_new(out/'SUMMARY.json', encoded(summary))
    info = {'schema': 'hepta.v56-one-helper-host-export-info.v1', 'phone_commands_in_export': 0,
        'original_helper_exit_code': args.helper_exit_code, 'source_result_sha256': sha(result_raw),
        'summary': reference(out/'SUMMARY.json', encoded(summary)), 'archive': packed['archive'],
        'previews': [{'role': v['role'], **v['preview'], 'original_png': v['original_png']} for v in visuals],
        'preview_base64_file': str(out/'PREVIEW-BASE64.json'), 'export_errors': errors,
        'business_qualified_by_export': False}
    write_new(out/'INFO.json', encoded(info))
    print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    return args.helper_exit_code


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run exactly one frozen v56 phone helper, then exec a host-only exporter.

This wrapper adds no device commands, permission, lock, retry, or business rule.
The original helper owns every phone operation and its actual exit is preserved.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy
import stat
import sys

BASE = Path('/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111')
RUNTIME = BASE / 'background-notes-adapters-v56-r1'
APK = "067ab5a286b100404fa2b00e341964cd70f005907988dc11eb486c9a4b3bab62"
COMMIT = "9f4168616546233033edd4b254b4236ae987ea7e"
BUILD = Path("/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/v56-main-sign-r1/RESULT.json")
SOURCE_TOOLS = Path("/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/v56-main-core101-materialized-host-r2/source/tools")
BUILD_SHA = "e27e74e94b0668c1c07b04863c9aaabf1b3235f9ff2d0d0d8bd9a346e46b2c6b"
EXPORTER = RUNTIME / 'export_v56_case_r1.py'
EXPORTER_SHA = '0c2859e41055f86404fba0ca859a8d75a434e410310d06f6d53bc44c300fb324'
HELPERS = {
    'prepare': ('prepare_background_notes_v56_r1.py', 'e841c36ed2e4489b82cb3a0f5e08e484e00ac018c7575bd7e892cfc1f1aeb6ee'),
    'run': ('run_background_notes_v56_r1.py', '8c58648825dd27035cd3271bfc5e57f912bfa9121dfbd39406da750e8a648834'),
}
HEX64 = re.compile(r'[0-9a-f]{64}\Z')
COMMON = {'test-mode', 'source-tools', 'adb', 'adb-host', 'adb-port', 'serial',
          'apk-sha256', 'expected-uid', 'main-physical-display-id', 'runtime-config',
          'plan', 'plan-sha256', 'command-timeout', 'out'}
PREPARE = {'ui-helper', 'background-driver', 'r7-driver', 'owner-root',
           'owner-start-ticks', 'owner-boot-id', 'owner-pid'}
RUN = {'identity-helper', 'build-receipt', 'build-receipt-sha256', 'preparation',
       'preparation-sha256', 'source-commit', 'target-package', 'prepared-screen',
       'prepared-screen-sha256', 'prepared-window-dump', 'prepared-window-dump-sha256',
       'start-window', 'timeout', 'interval'}
CANCEL = {'prepared-control-xml', 'prepared-control-xml-sha256'}


def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def identity(s):
    return (s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_mode, s.st_nlink, s.st_size, s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns)


def exact(path, maximum=32 << 20):
    path = Path(path)
    need(path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and BASE in path.parents
         and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (path, *path.parents)), 'exact nonsymlink host file required')
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_nlink == 1 and 0 < before.st_size <= maximum,
             'bounded regular nonempty host file required')
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    need(len(raw) == before.st_size and identity(before) == identity(after) == identity(path.stat()),
         'host file changed while reading')
    return raw, identity(before)


def strict(raw):
    def pairs(rows):
        value = {}
        for key, item in rows:
            need(key not in value, 'duplicate JSON key')
            value[key] = item
        return value
    def bad(value):
        raise ValueError('nonfinite JSON: ' + value)
    return json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=bad)


def options(kind, argv):
    need(isinstance(APK, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(APK)
         and isinstance(BUILD_SHA, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(BUILD_SHA)
         and isinstance(COMMIT, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', COMMIT)
         and isinstance(BUILD, Path) and BUILD.is_absolute()
         and isinstance(SOURCE_TOOLS, Path) and SOURCE_TOOLS.is_absolute(),
         'actual final v56 release fields pending; no phone helper may run')
    need(isinstance(argv, list) and 3 < len(argv) < 130
         and all(isinstance(x, str) and x and '\x00' not in x for x in argv), 'exact helper argv list required')
    helper = RUNTIME / HELPERS[kind][0]
    need(argv[:3] == ['/usr/bin/python3', '-u', str(helper)], 'only the frozen phone helper may run')
    arities = {x: 1 for x in COMMON | (PREPARE if kind == 'prepare' else RUN)}
    if kind != 'prepare':
        arities.update({'existing-su-authorized': 0, 'start-tap': 2})
    if kind == 'cancel':
        arities.update({x: 1 for x in CANCEL})
        arities.update({'cancel-visible-stop': 0, 'stop-tap': 2})
    parsed, i = {}, 3
    while i < len(argv):
        need(argv[i].startswith('--'), 'canonical flag form required')
        name = argv[i][2:]
        need(name in arities and name not in parsed, 'unknown or duplicate helper option: ' + name)
        count = arities[name]
        values = argv[i+1:i+1+count]
        need(len(values) == count and all(not x.startswith('--') for x in values), 'missing option value')
        parsed[name] = values if count != 1 else values[0]
        i += 1 + count
    for field in ('out', 'runtime-config', 'plan', 'plan-sha256', 'source-tools', 'apk-sha256', 'test-mode'):
        need(field in parsed, 'required frozen option missing: ' + field)
    need(parsed['apk-sha256'] == APK and parsed['source-tools'] == str(SOURCE_TOOLS),
         'actual v56 APK and source tools required')
    if kind == 'prepare':
        if parsed['test-mode'] == 'background_only':
            need((parsed['plan'], parsed['plan-sha256']) in {
                ('/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/background-notes-adapters-v56-r1/notes-plan-cancel-r1.json', 'ff3888e69651a7fc0f10740e10b49766c2234cf3cfd6056a617af838745ac292'),
                ('/home/alex/hepta-local-007f-20261111/background-notes-adapters-v56-r1/notes-plan-recovery-r1.json', 'ac7f258399e5738baff01d9aa067433879355be33b7bec8926e87f61d13584e9'),
            }, 'background-only preparation requires exact reviewed cancel or recovery plan')
        else:
            need(parsed['test-mode'] == 'main_user_coexistence', 'original preparation mode required')
    else:
        need(parsed.get('build-receipt') == str(BUILD) and parsed.get('build-receipt-sha256') == BUILD_SHA
             and parsed.get('source-commit') == COMMIT and parsed.get('target-package') == 'com.motorola.stylus',
             'actual signed Notes run binding required')
    if kind == 'cancel':
        need(parsed['test-mode'] == 'background_only' and 'cancel-visible-stop' in parsed,
             'only the separate original cancellation mode is allowed')
    return helper, parsed


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=tuple(HELPERS), required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--helper-argv-json', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--export-out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    argv = strict(args.helper_argv_json.encode('utf-8'))
    helper, values = options(args.kind, argv)
    source, out = Path(values['out']), args.export_out
    need(source.parent == out.parent == BASE and re.fullmatch(r'background-notes-v56-[a-z0-9-]+', source.name)
         and out.name == source.name+'-host-review-r1' and not source.exists() and not out.exists()
         and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in (*source.parents, *out.parents)),
         'new exact case and sibling export directories required')
    snapshots = {helper: exact(helper), EXPORTER: exact(EXPORTER), BUILD: exact(BUILD),
                 Path(values['runtime-config']): exact(Path(values['runtime-config']), 16384),
                 Path(values['plan']): exact(Path(values['plan']), 16384)}
    need(sha(snapshots[helper][0]) == HELPERS[args.kind][1] and HEX64.fullmatch(EXPORTER_SHA)
         and sha(snapshots[EXPORTER][0]) == EXPORTER_SHA and sha(snapshots[BUILD][0]) == BUILD_SHA,
         'helper/exporter/actual signed receipt byte pin differs')
    build = strict(snapshots[BUILD][0])
    need(build.get('all_pass') is True and build.get('apk_sha256') == APK and build.get('source_commit') == COMMIT,
         'actual signed v56 identity differs')
    plan_raw = snapshots[Path(values['plan'])][0]
    need(HEX64.fullmatch(values['plan-sha256']) and sha(plan_raw) == values['plan-sha256'], 'immutable plan SHA differs')
    config_sha = sha(snapshots[Path(values['runtime-config'])][0])
    original_argv = sys.argv
    sys.argv = argv[2:]
    try:
        # Exactly one phone helper. Its original owner/lock and all predicates remain in force.
        runpy.run_path(str(helper), run_name='__main__')
        exit_code = 0
    except SystemExit as error:
        exit_code = 0 if error.code is None else error.code
        need(type(exit_code) is int and 0 <= exit_code <= 255, 'original helper exit is not a bounded integer')
    finally:
        sys.argv = original_argv
    for path, before in snapshots.items():
        need(exact(path) == before, 'original helper or immutable input changed: ' + str(path))
    raw, _ = exact(source/'RESULT.json')
    # Fresh interpreter avoids reloading a phone helper or bypassing a preloaded-module guard.
    os.execv('/usr/bin/python3', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(EXPORTER),
        '--kind', args.kind, '--source-root', str(source), '--out', str(out),
        '--expected-result-sha256', sha(raw), '--expected-config-sha256', config_sha,
        '--plan', values['plan'], '--expected-plan-sha256', values['plan-sha256'],
        '--helper-sha256', HELPERS[args.kind][1], '--helper-exit-code', str(exit_code)])
    raise RuntimeError('execv unexpectedly returned')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
